Mr. Tsunoda
As we have already explained, as a result of our investigation, we have confirmed that the consumption tax on the BIP invoice is calculated from the "Registration fee tax amount" item on the NV estimate.
The tax amount was calculated correctly in Siebel, but the value of the item was manually changed by the user, and as a result of the changed value being carried over to subsequent estimates and SO, we have confirmed that the same value is reflected in the invoice BIP.
In the UAT environment, we reproduced a similar scenario of manually changing item values ​​and conducted various test cases and regression tests. The value only changed when the user made a manual update, otherwise the value was calculated and maintained correctly. Also, no other factors were identified that could change this value. Therefore, we have confirmed that this issue is not a functional issue with Siebel, but rather a data modification by the user.
*About countermeasures*
As explained at the meeting, the current countermeasure is to make the existing "Registration Fee Tax Amount" item for reference only and add another editable item on the same screen. We believe that this will allow users to clearly understand the values ​​that have been manually changed, and will make it easier to identify the cause of similar discrepancies in the future.
On Siebel's side, the investigation into this matter has been completed, and no issues have been identified with current functionality, nor are there any events that require additional preventive measures at this time. Additionally, since this event has only occurred in one case so far, we have not determined that the issue is due to Siebel functionality.
Thank you for your support.
Tanish

comments.text:
Thank you for your continued support.
We would like to share the analysis details for incident MFTBCFFR-5488, regarding the sync issue in the UV Sales Order.
Issue:
The Profit of the Sales Order and the latest Quote revision are not aligned.
Root Cause Analysis (RCA):
The issue occurred because Sub Quote 1-7DUHTZ was synced to the UV Sales Quote after the sales quote had already been approved and synced to the Sales Order. This was possible because the "Update Customer Quote" button on the Sub Quote detail view remains active even after the Sales Quote status is set to "Initial Approval Completed".
We have successfully replicated this issue in the FDP UAT-1 environment (Reference Record: UV Quote#: 1-6UW1UZ, UV SO#: E001303159).
Steps to Reproduce:
# Create a UV Sales Quote and add an Activity.
# Create a Job Card from the Activity.
# In the UV Sales Quote, click 'Generate Approval' and proceed to create the UV Sales Order.
# In the Job Card, complete the Work Order and create a Service Quote.
# Click "Update Sales Quote" button in the Service Quote to create a Sub Quote under the UV Sales Quote.
# Observe that the UV Sales Quote status is "Initial Approval Completed", but the "Update Customer Quote" button remains active.
# Click "Update Customer Quote" to sync Service items to the UV Sales Quote.
# Note that these items are not synced to the UV Sales Order.
Fix Plan:
Once the UV Sales Quote status is "Initial Approval Completed", if a user attempts to click the "Update Customer Quote" button in the Sub Quote tab, a validation message will be displayed:
"Sales Quote has already been completed."
Recovery Status: Recovery has been completed.
Kindly review the proposed fix plan and let us know if you have any questions or concerns.
Regards,
Sunaina Gill

comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
*RCA*: When the first vehicle record was created, the model code for that vehicle was not yet available in the Production environment. Because of this, the vehicle was created without a model code. Later, the model code was added to the Production environment.
When the system tried to update the existing vehicle record, it searched for a vehicle with that model code. Since the original vehicle record did not contain the model code, the system could not find the existing vehicle. As a result, the system created a new vehicle record with the correct model code, which led to duplicate vehicle records.
Example: Hakodate Production
Vehicle: MS06GP-20085
*19 Dec 2025:* First vehicle record created (without model code).
*23 Dec 2025:* Model code was added to Production(SR MFTBCFFR-5162).
*24 Dec 2025:* System attempted to update the vehicle record.
Since the original record had no model code, the system created another vehicle with the correct model code, causing duplication.
*Recovery Plan:* We have extracted all the impacted Vehicles and Sales order on which recovery is required. We are proceeding with recovering all the Sales Order first so that users can proceed with business operations. Please find attached list of all the impacted Vehicles and Sales Orders. We are performing the recovery and will inform you soon once it gets completed. 
*Fix Plan:* No Fix plan is required as this is a data issue rather than a system issue. This issue occurred because the model code was not available in the production environment. Same occurrence is also observed in SC version also. 
Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Regarding this issue, we would like to report the RCA and countermeasures as follows.
■ RCA (Cause)
When creating the vehicle record for the first time, the model code of the vehicle was not registered in the production environment.
Therefore, a vehicle record was created without a model code.
The model code was then registered in the production environment.
When the system tried to update an existing vehicle record, it performed a search using the model code as a key, but the existing record did not include the model code, so it could not identify the record.
As a result, a new vehicle record was created with the correct model code, resulting in a duplicate.
■ Countermeasures
We have introduced a monitoring script to detect similar events, and are now able to receive email notifications when a target record occurs.

comments.text:
Please find the detailed analysis below:
In NV Sales Order, when a user creates a Registration Request, the Vendor Code is derived from the Registration Request Master based on the Registration Location specified in the NV Sales Order.
For the affected records, the associated Vendor Code did not contain the required Accounts Payable information, which led to the reported issue. After correcting the Vendor Code, the user was able to successfully create the Registration Request with the correct Registration items.
This is clearly a Master Data issue rather than a Siebel System Issue. Hence, no fix is required on the Siebel side.
Additionally, it is understood that the Registration Master data has already been updated, and the user was able to proceed with the registration process successfully. As such, no further master data updates are required at this stage.
Going forward, validation of the Registration Master data through SR MFTBCFFR-5501 will help prevent recurrence of similar issues.
Given the above, all points have been addressed and no further action is pending from our side. We would like to proceed with the closure of this Jira ticket.
Regards,
Sunaina Gill

As discussed in today’s meeting, regarding the requirement that users should be able to proceed and complete the Registration process, we have conducted our analysis. Please find the details below:
1.) Condition for JV creation
For Registration Items, the JV is created only when both of the following conditions are met:
1.1 The registration item must correspond to a Tax line item. The Part# for these registration line items are 'S02', 'S03', or 'S06'.
1.2 The actual amount of these registration items should be greater than zero.
In short, JV is created only for tax-related registration items (S02, S03, S06) with a actual amount greater than zero.
2.) Observation in the Referenced Case
In the referenced case, the user is able to proceed and complete the Registration Request. However, the JV will not be created for these Registration line items.
This is because the relevant registration items corresponding to tax items are not created, as the Vendor Codes are not maintained.

本件について分析を行いましたので、結果をご報告いたします。
 
条件１：税確定前には、いくつかのバリデーションが実施されます。
いずれかの明細において「税込実績金額」が0より大きい場合、以下の5項目が必須となります。
 
a. ベンダーコード（Vendor Code）

c. 支払条件（Payment Term）
d. 仕入業者支払日（Vendor Payment Term）

条件２：
いずれかの明細において、部品番が「S02」「S03」「S06」のいずれかであり、かつ「税込実績金額」が0より大きい場合、上記の必須項目に加えて、「受注先コード」「顧客支払」「顧客支払タイプ」も必須となります。
 
なお、これらの項目については顧客マスタから自動的に設定されるため、手動で入力する必要はありません。

comments.text_enu:
thank you always.
 
We have analyzed this matter and would like to report the results.
 
Condition 1: Several validations will be carried out before the tax is finalized.
If the "actual amount including tax" in any item is greater than 0, the following 5 items are required.
 
a. Vendor Code
b. Vendor Payment Method
c. Payment Term
d. Vendor Payment Term
e. Vendor House Bank
 
Condition 2:
In any item, if the part number is one of "S02", "S03", or "S06" and "Actual amount including tax" is greater than 0, in addition to the above required items, "Sold-to party code", "Customer payment", and "Customer payment type" are also required.
 
Please note that these items are automatically set from the customer master record, so there is no need to enter them manually.
Also, there is no need to make these fields editable.
 
Thank you for your understanding.
Regards,
ravi raghuvanshi

comments.author: Sunaina Gill
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
Please note that the "Profit Amount High Flag" is a backend field which is used to configure the approval flow conditions correctly. Its function is to identify cases where, after a revision of the NV Quote, the approval flow is triggered based on the Sales Profit value. For your reference, the relevant condition is shown in the attached screenshot.
To configure the attached conditions, for cases where NV Quote is revised and the value of its Sales Profit remains same or increases, the value of "Profit Amount High Flag" is set to 'Y'. The cases where NV Quote is revised and the value of its Sales Profit decreases, the value of this flag is set to 'N'.
In addition, we have checked all approval flows on Okayama Production environment, and all cases are functioning correctly. We have checked all approval flow scenarios in the FDP UAT-1 environment as well and confirm that all approval flows are working as expected.
Reference Records:
Environment: FDP UAT-1
(Sales Profit Amount High Case) NV Quote#: 1-82OKSZ
(Sales Profit Amount decreases) NV Quote#: 1-82OKL3
Please note that for the affected record on Okayama Production environment, the value of Profit Amount High Flag was updated to 'Y' due to a case of multi-browsing by user. We have replicated the issue on FDP UAT-1 environment using the same method. Reference Test record:
Environment: FDP UAT-1
NV Quote#: 1-839SHJ
If you require any further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Best regards,
Sunaina Gill

comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
This issue is replicable on UAT, please follow these steps to replicate it on UAT-1 ->
1) Create a New Job Card
 2) Create a work order and add Line Items (Parts, Labor and Lubrication) in it.
 3) Create/Sync Quote and make the quote customer approved.
 4) Now Labor list price will be same in JCO and Quote.
 5) Go to Work Order Line Items cancel one of the labor.
 6) In quote the price of cancelled labor is removed, but in JCO price of cancelled labor is still there. so, there is a difference in
   Labor List Price at Quote and JCO.
 7) Now close the Job Card without syncing service quote to JCO
 
 At this point, we can see a price mismatch:
 Quote shows the reduced labor price
 JCO still shows the higher labor price.
 
 We have performed thorough analysis of this issue and found the root cause:-
RCA:
 When a user cancels any line item (labor/parts/lubricants) in the Work Order, the system immediately updates the total price in the Quote.
 However, the JCO price is not updated at the same time.
 The JCO price is updated only when a quote is created and customer approved after the cancellation of Line Items.
 So, if a line item is cancelled after quote is customer approved, and user does not create and customer approved a new quote but he directly closes the Job Card. Then the JCO continues to display the old price, while the Quote shows the updated price.
 This is why a price difference appears between the Quote and the JCO.
 
Fix Plan:
We are currently evaluating different possible fix options for this issue.
 Please allow us to schedule a meeting with you, so we can discuss the available approaches and decide on the most suitable fix plan.
 Meanwhile Let us know in case of any query.
Regards,
 Ayaz

 Thank you very much for your continued support.
 Regarding the incident*, the investigation results are as follows.
|Incident number|MFTBCFFR-5317|
|Event Details|The status of the Assessment Request cannot be updated to "Completed" or "Cancelled." |
|RCA|This case is a request for appraisal regarding an Unstock Vehicle.
 
The appraisal request was created by user ID D8HIHARA (role: Branch-Sales-Staff).
After approval, the status of the appraisal request is updated to "Submitted to UV".
 
Then, when UV staff processes the assessment request,
By setting the "Quotation Vehicle Allocation" flag to "Y",
This appraisal request has been determined as an Unstock Vehicle case.
 
With existing functionality, if an appraisal request is created by Branch-Sales-Staff,
Only the following statuses can be edited.
 
Submitted to UV
 
JAAI Assessment In Progress
 
Assessment In Progress
 
Rejected
 
In progress
 
Assessment Completed
 
If a status other than the above is set, the appraisal request will be read-only.
 
In this case, the status of the appraisal request was set to “Vehicle for Quotation”, so
The status was set to Read-Only, and UV staff were unable to update it to "Completed." |
|Recovery status|Based on your instructions, we implemented recovery measures on February 3rd.
The status of the appraisal request has been updated to "Cancelled". |
|Correction Plan|As a result of checking the entire FDP production environment, no other incidents similar to this issue have occurred.
We have confirmed that the phenomenon itself is operating as the existing function.
 
However, in light of this issue, we plan to implement the following modifications.
 
Even if the appraisal request is created by Branch-Sales-Staff,
When the status is set to “Vehicle for Quotation”,
Change the logic to still set the status to Editable.
 
Once we receive approval for this response policy, we will proceed with modifications to the UAT environment. |
|Scheduled date of implementation of UAT|February 10, 2026|
 
Please contact us if you have any questions.
 Thank you for your understanding.
 Himanshu Tandon

|RCA|本件は、対象の本番レコード（AR番号：H000522508、見積番号：2-AJ8LJK）が *在庫外車両（Unstock Vehicle）* のケースであったことが原因で発生しました。
 このケースでは、*シャーシ番号が査定に紐づけられていません。*
UV販売見積における利益計算では、*車両明細* と *非車両明細* の価格が、*型式コード明細に存在する Vehicle ID* を基に個別に計算されます。
しかし、在庫外車両（Unstock Vehicle）の場合、型式コード明細にシャーシが存在しないため、*Vehicle ID が空白のままとなります。*
その結果、型式コードが *非車両明細* として判定されてしまいました。
 システムが販売利益計算時に型式コード明細を正しく識別できないため、*型式コードの価格が二重に控除される事象が発生しました。*|
|リカバリー状況|完了済|
|修正プラン|本件の対応として、非車両明細（Non-Vehicle Line Item） の検索条件を修正しました。
Vehicle ID が空白であり、かつ Product Type が「型式コード」ではないレコード を判定します。
これにより、在庫外車両（Unstock Vehicle）の場合でも、型式の明細が非車両明細として誤判定されることはなくなります。|
|UAT予定日|UATで修正済みとなっております。
 AR#: H000052299
 UV Quote#: 1-7WLRVD|

Thank you for your support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-5306, related to Profit Calculation Mismatch in UV Sales Quote.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5306|
|Description|UV Sales Quote Profit Mismatch|
|Root Cause (RCA)|This issue occured because the affected Production Record (AR#: H000522508, Quote#: 2-AJ8LJK) is a case of Unstock Vehicle. In this scenario, the Chassis# is not mapped to the assessment.
During profit calculation in UV Sales Quote, Vehicle and Non-Vehicle line item prices are calculated separately based on the Vehicle ID, which is present only in the Model Code line item.
In the case of Vehicle Unstock, Chassis is not present in Model Code line item and thus its Vehicle Id remains blank. Due to this Model Code is considered as Non-Vehicle Line Item. Since the system fails to correctly identify the Model Code line item during Sales Profit calculation, this results in the Model Code price being deducted twice.|
|Recovery status|Recovery has been completed on January 30.|
|Fix Plan|To fix this issue, we have updated the search spec for Non-Vehicle Line Items. Now it will identify records which are having Blank Vehicle Id and the Product Type is not 'Model Code'.
This will ensure that in case of Unstock Vehicle, Model Code Line item is not considered as Non-Vehicle line item.|
|Planned UAT date|The fix has been implemented on UAT1 environment.
Reference record:
AR#: H000052299
UV Quote#: 1-7WLRVD|
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
Best Regards

Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed the incident and identified that the mismatch in the Total List Price between the SV Quote and the UV Quote is caused by a difference in pricing logic between the two quotes.
In the SV Quote, for the following Labor Billing Types:
 - Shaken
 - 3-month Inspection
 - 6-month Inspection
 - 12-month Inspection
 - 24-month Inspection
 - MPC Shaken
 - PDF Shaken
 - MPC + PDF Shaken
 - Spare Tire – Toolbox
the Adjusted List Price is stored directly.
 However, in the UV Quote, this logic is not implemented, and the multiplication with Qty is applied in all cases.
As a recovery measure, we propose manually updating the price in the UV Quote. Please confirm whether this recovery approach is correct and meets your expectations.
To permanently resolve this issue, we plan to implement the same pricing logic used in the SV Quote into the UV Quote.
Please let us know if you have any questions or require further clarification.
Regards,
Sunaina Gill

|mailto:yuji.yoshihara@daimlertruck.com] San,
Thank you very much for your continued support.
As a result of investigating this issue, we confirmed that when testing CR-4982, the PR object in the manifest management screen was changed to inactive in the development environment.
The configuration was then migrated to RT2 and production.
This event occurred because the PR file became inactive, affecting the transition when pressing the "VECT" button.
The configuration has now been fixed and the issue is resolved in all production and UAT environments. As a preventative measure, we will conduct additional checks during migration to ensure that no unnecessary configuration changes have been reflected in the production environment.
In addition, we will add confirmation of the "VECT" function to the daily morning sanity check items to create a system that can detect and prevent similar events at an early stage.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. We will strive to prevent similar incidents from occurring again in the future. 
Thank you for your support.
Himanshu Tandon

We would like to share the analysis details for the Incident MFTBCFFR-5180, related to Tax amount finalization error.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5180|
|Description|Tax amount finalization error|
|User Steps|Step 1: In the related UV Sales Quote, user has manually changed the items of Tax and Expenses and updated one Expense Item to 'Tax'.
Step 2: User created a Sales Order.
Step 3: User created an Invoice and completed it.
Step 4: User created a Registration Request and clicked on 'Finalize Tax Amount' button.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|We have successfully replicated this issue in UAT-1 environment (Reference Record: UV Sales Quote : 1-6XPN5P revision 5, UV Sales Order : E001300882).
When an invoice is created, the status of line items with Type as 'Tax' is automatically updated to Invoiced. However, a manually updated line item with Part Number 'YN6M' and Type as 'Tax' did not have its status changed to Invoiced.
During Tax Finalization, the status of all line items having Type as 'Tax', including manually updated ones (such as part number YN6M), must be set to Invoiced.|
|Recovery status|Please note that we have checked and found that no such case of manually updating the Expense Line item to 'Tax' has been observed in any FDP Production Environment.
As this is a case of user misoperation, so no recovery is required.
Kindly ask the user to revise the UV Sales Quote, and update the correct expense line items. |
|Fix Plan|NA|
As this is a case of user mis-operation, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.

Dear Tsunoda San,
 
型式コードがD21Aファイル処理時点でシステムに登録されていない場合については、以下のような対応を実装することが可能です。
 
型式コードが存在しない場合は、シャーシオーダーを作成しない。
対象レコードの情報をAMSチームへメールで自動通知する。
AMSチームにて通知内容を確認し、必要なデータ修正を実施した後、再処理を行う。
 
この対応により、型式コードが未登録の状態でシャーシオーダーが作成されることを防止し、問題の早期検知および迅速な対応が可能となります。
 
ご不明な点やご質問がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。

Dear Tsunoda san
Thank you for your continued support.
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident# MFTBCFFR-5069 reported on December 04, 2025, related to delivery approval error in NV Sales Order on Wakayama Production environment.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number|MFTBCFFR-5069|
|Description|A delivery approval error was displayed in NV Sales Order, thus preventing the user from completing the process.|
|Root Cause (RCA)|Please note that both affected NV Sales Order# A000009087 and A000011464, have product class as 'Trailer'. In this case, when the Sales Order is Approved, a purchase order having type as 'Trailer & Forklift' is automatically created. 
Subsequently, when the status of this Purchase Order is updated to "Ordered", the system creates a new Vehicle record and populates its Vehicle ID in both the Purchase Order and the corresponding Sales Order.
For the affected records in Wakayama Production, the Sales Orders were approved successfully and the corresponding Purchase Orders were generated. When the Purchase Orders status was updated to "Ordered", new Vehicle records were created as expected.
However, the issue occurred because the Vehicle Id of this newly created Vehicle was populated correctly in the Purchase Order but was not populated in the corresponding Sales Order. During the Delivery Approval process, the system validates the Vehicle information between the Purchase Order and Sales Order. Due to the Vehicle ID mismatch, the validation failed and the Delivery Approval error message was displayed.|
|Recovery status|Completed|
|Fix Plan|We have reviewed this issue at the code level and confirmed that there is no defect in the current implementation and the process is working as expected. We attempted to replicate this issue in UAT environment but this issue could not be replicated.
We have monitored this issue over the past few months, and no recurrence has been observed on any production environment.
Also please note that the affected Purchase Orders were completed in March 2025 whereas the issue was reported in December 2025. Due to the significant time gap , some information is not available to access the issue. As a result, while we were able to identify that the Delivery Approval error was caused by a Vehicle ID mismatch between the Purchase Order and Sales Order, we do not currently have sufficient information to determine why the Vehicle ID was not populated in the Sales Order at that time. 
We will continue to monitor the system, and if a similar issue occurs in the future, we will investigate it immediately and take the necessary corrective actions.
Since there are no pending actions at this time and the issue has not recurred, we would like to proceed with closing this ticket.|
Regards
Sunaina Gill

|Event|An error occurred when approving the delivery of the NV order, and an event occurred that made it impossible to complete the process. |
|RCA|We have confirmed that the product class of the applicable NV orders (A000009087, A000011464) is "Trailer". In this case, once the order is approved, the system will automatically create a purchase order of type "Trailer & Forklift".
If you then change the status of the purchase order to "Ordered", a new vehicle record will be automatically created and that vehicle ID will be set on the purchase order and related orders.
In the target record, order approval and purchase order creation were completed successfully, and even when the purchase order was changed to "Ordered", the vehicle record was created successfully.
However, although the vehicle ID of the created vehicle was successfully set on the purchase order, it was not set on the corresponding sales order.
In the vehicle delivery approval process, a consistency check is performed between the vehicle information on the purchase order and the received order, but in this case, because the vehicle IDs did not match, a validation error occurred and the vehicle delivery could not be approved. |
|Recovery status|Completed|
|Fix Plan|As a result of conducting an investigation at the code level, we have confirmed that there are no defects in the current logic and that the functionality is working properly.
We also tried to reproduce the same phenomenon in the UAT environment, but were unable to reproduce it.
Furthermore, we have been conducting monitoring for several months since this incident occurred, and the similar incident has not recurred in any of our production environments.
The purchase order in question was completed in March 2025, and this incident was reported in December 2025. Because a long period of time has passed between the incident and the report, some investigation information cannot be obtained.
Therefore, although we were able to confirm that the direct cause of the delivery approval error was a "vehicle ID mismatch between the purchase order and the received order," there is currently no information available to determine why the vehicle ID was not set on the order receiving side at that time.
We will continue to monitor the situation and will promptly investigate and respond if a similar incident occurs.
As there is no action to be taken at this time and no recurrence has been confirmed, we would like to close this ticket. |

Thank you for your continued support.
We have completed our analysis of the reported issue and would like to share our findings. 
RCA (Root Cause Analysis):
During our of Parts Sales Return Orders where the VIN# and Registration# fields were blank, we observed that the corresponding parent Parts Sales Orders and the originating Parts Quotes also contained blank values for these fields. Since the VIN# and Registration# details were not entered at the initial Parts Quote stage, the same was carried forward to the Parts Sales Order and subsequently to the Parts Sales Return Order.
For validation, we created two sample records  on FDP UAT1 for Parts Sales Return Orders:
M001300484 – with VIN# and Registration# populated
M001300482 – with no VIN# and Registration# 
The PBI report(PT5-10) correctly reflected the VIN of M001300484 as VIN values added in Parts quote.
 
Based on our analysis, this behavior is not an issue on the Siebel side or the PBI side. The root cause is that the VIN# and Registration# fields were not entered by the user at the time of creating the initial Parts Quote.
Since it is not a system issue, kindly allow us to reject this incident.  
Please let us know if you require any further information.
Best Regards,
Abhinav

comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
*RCA*:
*(1) Reason for Payment Terms were included in UAT4–8 but not reflected in PROD:*
 The Payment Condition values displayed in the BIP are based on the PO Sheet master. During the initial setup for Wave-3, the master data for these Payment Conditions was not provided by biz.
 When the incident *MFTBCFFR-4978* was raised, the missing values were added across all UAT environments, and the master data was uploaded based on the values that were already present in *OKAYAMA-PROD*. However, since the required master data was not available during the initial PROD deployment, the Payment Terms were not reflected in the Wave-3 PROD environments.
*(2) Reason for differences across FDP environments (Wave-3 & Chugoku):*
 In the Shikoku and Wakayama PROD environments, hardcoded Payment Condition values already exist in the BIP configuration. Therefore, Payment Terms appear only in these specific FDP environments.
 In contrast, other FDPs i.e. *Iwate, Okinawa, and Chugoku,* do not have such hardcoded values, which results in the observed differences in Payment Term display across Wave-3 PROD environments.
*Fix and release plan:*

Dear Tsunoda san,
Thank you for your continued support.
We have thoroughly investigated this issue, and our findings are as follows:
*Issue:*
 The user was unable to print the "仕様書 2" BIP report.
*Root Cause:*
 The price for Part MK645741 was found to be null, which caused the BIP report to fail, as the price field cannot be null for part line items.
 Additionally, we identified that users are able to edit the quantity directly in the Sales Order, which is not aligned with the correct business process. Quantity changes must be performed through the Quote. Since the user modified the quantity in the Sales Order, the price was set to null, resulting in the BIP failure.
A similar incident occurred previously in the SC version (INC4031968). As part of the fix for that issue, the quantity field was made read-only to prevent modifications in the Sales Order.
Please find below the screenshot of UAT test record for your reference:
*Fix Plan:*
 We will apply the same approach by making the quantity field read-only for parts. This will prevent null price errors and ensure that BIP reports are generated successfully.
Kindly review and confirm our proposed fix plan. Please let us know if you have any questions or need further clarification.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

comments.text:
We would like to share the analysis details for the incident MFTBCFFR-5016 reported on 25th November 2025, related to the JV of consumption tax of Accounts Receivable was not created, after Sales Posting Customer Account was Changed.
Please find the summary below:
|Incident Number |MFTBCFFR-5016|
|Description|NV FDP中国 売上後の取引先変更で消費税の仕訳が出ない|
|Root Cause (RCA)|When NV/UV Quote is revised after SO Sales Posting, and certain field values(Price and other info) are changed, Revised Journal Vouchers are created
 with the updated values. In this case, Customer Account is changed and upon quote approval, only 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' JV was created, Consumption Tax JV was not created. We have replicated this issue on UAT1:
SO # A001299134, A001299093
This issue occurred because as per the existing logic, Revise Journal Voucher is created only for those Journal Vouchers Items where Sales Amount is changed, if Selling Amount is not changed then in that case only one JV 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' is created.|
|Recovery status|Will do after confirmation from Shiromoto San|
|Fix Plan|To fix this, we will update the logic so that Consumption Tax Journal is created with 'Revise Sales Posting Selling' Journal
 even if Sales Amount is not changed and other values like account is changed.
We will fix it on UAT by today end of day, if fix approval is received.|
|Planned UAT date|25th November, 2025|
|Next update|26th November, 2025|
Also, response to your queries is :
 1. *Is there any past JV？* >> Since this logic has been in place since FDP go-live, there are past JVs affected.
2.  *For UV, is it in the same situation of After Sales Posting?* >> Yes, the same functionality applies to UV as well.
3. *Do other FDPs have same specification?*>> Yes, the logic is same across all FDPs.
The issue has been *fixed on UAT1* after receiving your approval for the fix plan.
 We have also received *production deployment approval* from Shiromoto San, and this will be released in the *26th November release*.
If you require further clarification or assistance, please feel free to reach out.
We appreciate your continued cooperation.
      
Best Regards,
 Atul Yadav

*Fix Plan:*
 * We will make *Return Good Qty* and *Return Defective Qty* permanently *read-only*, regardless of shipment status.
 * We will fix this issue on *FDP-UAT1 by 18/11/2025 (EOD)*.

Abhinav

The user initially created the Chassis Order B050208984 with the Model Code FBA20B21W00F-5-G830, and the corresponding vehicle record was also created with this Model Code on 30 May 2025.
 
On 7 November 2025, a D21A file was received from TOB, containing the same Model Code FBA20B21W00F-5-G830.
 
However, after the vehicle was created on 30 May 2025, the Model Code in the vehicle record was modified by user from FBA20B21W00F-5-G830 to FBA20B21W00F-4-G830.
 
Due to this mismatch, the current D21A ODI package identified the data as a new record and consequently created a new vehicle and a new chassis order B050481404, resulting in duplication in chassis order and recycle fee order and line items.
This is a case of User mis-operation where user updated the model code in vehicle due to which correct file with MC 5 created a duplicate order. 
Additionally, these type of cases will be handled by Vehicle cleansing CR. Since, recovery is completed and no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this incident. 
Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
After the data extraction, an update SQL is used to update the flag of the record that is been sent to KB in bulk processing. This SQL was updating the flag on the basis of the order number rather than shipment. If any order had one target shipment to be sent to KB, the flag was updated for all the shipment. 
We have now fixed this SQL on all the production environment and correct flag updates are made now. 
Additionally, we have identified the recovery target for 20th closing and performed the recovery yesterday and all the correct data has been sent to KB. We will continue our monitoring till November EOM closing. 
Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.

comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have thoroughly analyzed this issue, and our findings are as follows:
The user is creating an Insurance Order and then generating the Policy Number through the Ejibai interface. However, the Ejibai response is not being sent back to Siebel. Instead, the policy is created in Ejibai, and the user is manually updating the Liability Insurance Policy # field in the Insurance Order, as it is currently editable.
When the Policy Number is populated in the Insurance Order through the Ejibai response, the backend field User Key gets updated automatically. However, when the Policy Number is entered manually, the User Key remains null. Therefore, when that same policy is sent again from Ejibai to Siebel, the system does not find the original record (due to the missing User Key) and creates a duplicate order.
We successfully replicated this issue on UAT4 with the help of Gayatri-san. Please refer to the Insurance Order Q000037255 and its duplicate Q000037256.
Replication steps performed:
Step 1: Created an Insurance Order in Siebel and proceeded with policy creation on the Ejibai side.
Step 2: Manually updated the Liability Insurance Policy # in the Insurance Order instead of sending the response from the Ejibai interface.
Step 3: Sent the Policy Number again from Ejibai.
Conclusion:
This is not a system defect but a user mis-operation, where the Policy Number is being updated manually rather than being linked through the Ejibai interface. Kindly inform the user to avoid such manual updates to prevent duplication issues.
Since no further action is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this incident. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Thank you for your support and cooperation.
As per our discussion and demonstration in the meeting. We explained why the Order Detail BIP report failed to generate in case of Trailer & Forklift.
 *Issue* : Failure in generation of Order Detail BIP report.
 *Cause* : Tax rate was null in Sales Order as well as in Sales Quote. *Tax rate* is calculated on the basis of *Planned Delivery Date* in the sales quote which is then passed on to the Sales Order. In case of Trailer and Forklift, the validation on Planned Delivery Date is not present to get the Sales Quote approval due to which, the tax rate is not calculated *whenever the date field is left empty* in the sales quote. As a result null tax rate is passed on to the Sales Order causing the BIP to fail.
 We plan and hope to provide the fix by today EOD on UAT environment.
Best Regards,
 Saad

Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
*Issue*: Different Model Codes were present in Quote and Sales Order.
*RCA*: We have found that Chassis & Options Tab in Line Items of NV Sales Order is editable for some responsibilities.
 
 Instead of changing the Model code from NV Quote, some users were changing the Model Code from this tab in Sales Order. Please find attached all the impacted NV Sales Orders. 
 
*Fix Plan*: Model Code should not be changed from the NV Sales Order. The correct business procedure for changing Model code is to change the model code from the NV Quote and then sync the Quote to Sales Order. Hence we will make the Product Name field read only in Chassis & Options tab. This will ensure that no such user miss-operations happens again. 
Kindly approve this fix plan. 
Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional information.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

いつもお世話になっております。
 
本件について詳細な分析を行いましたので、以下に結果をご報告いたします。
 
■ 問題内容:
見積と受注（SO）において異なる型式コードが存在していました。

一部の責任区分において、NV受注（NVSO)の明細にある「シャーシ & オプション」タブが編集可能となっていました。

正しい運用手順としては、NV見積で型式コードを変更し、その後見積を受注へ同期する必要があります。
そのため、「シャーシ & オプション」タブ内の「製品名」フィールドを読み取り専用に設定し、今後同様の操作ミスが発生しないようにいたします。
 
上記修正計画につきまして、ご承認をお願いいたします。

thank you always.
 
We have conducted a detailed analysis of this matter and would like to report the results below.
 
■ Question details:
There were different model codes in the quote and order (SO).
 
■ Cause (RCA):
The Chassis & Options tab in the NVSO details was editable for some responsibility categories.
So, we found that instead of changing the model code from the NV quote, some users were changing it directly on this tab (NVSO).
Please see the attached file (Recovery_Records_FDP.xlsx) for a list of affected NVSOs.
 
■ Fix Plan:
The model code cannot be changed directly from NVSO.
The correct operating procedure is to change the model code in the NV quotation and then synchronize the quotation to the sales order.

Thank you for your support.
*RCA*:
As discussed in the meeting, this issue occurred due to the execution of the file received for the Lubrication Master (i.e. MFTBCFFR - 4830) for UAT1 and FDP-Okayama. The file contained the value ‘N’ for the Generic Flag field. As a result, the pre-default logic in the Lubrication Master led to the 'Outsourcing Lubricant Carry-in' field being set to ‘N’, since this value is directly derived from the Lubrication Master data.
For Dummy Lubrication Parts, the value of this flag should always be ‘Y’ in the master data.
The recovery has been completed, and we have reset the value of the Generic Flag back to ‘Y’.
*Countermeasure*:
As discussed, whenever the Lubrication Price Master data needs to be uploaded, we kindly request you to:
->Provide only the Price files if updates are required only for the lubrication pricing.
->Provide both Lubrication Master and Lubrication Price Master files if new lubrication data needs to be added in the FDPs.
Additionally, we will update our SOP to include a check for the Generic Flag value for dummy parts whenever a Lubrication Master file is received. We will also inform you in case any data update is required to maintain consistency across systems.
Since this was a data issue and not a system issue, please allow us to close this incident.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Soham

Thank you for your continued support.
 
We have analyzed the issue and would like to share the following findings:
Root Cause Analysis (RCA):
When a Job Card (JC) is initially created from the NV or UV side, the “Internal Order (Charge To)” field is populated. However, if the user changes the JC Type to any other Type let's say “11: Chargeable” while the JC Status is still Open, and then revert the JC Type back to NV or UV, the “Internal Order (Charge To)” field becomes blank.
This behavior aligns with the fix plan referenced in MFTBCFFR-3706, where the following fields are reset when the JC Type is changed from NV/UV:
 * Internal Order (Charge To)
 * Internal Order Number
This issue can be successfully replicated on FDP-UAT1.
Please let us know if any further details or clarification are required.
Best regards,
 Abhinav

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
User is performing the following steps in service quote line item while updating the manual discount % in all the line items:
UAT1 test record "1-6WGYRW":
Step 1: Click on an editable field:
Step 2: Now select all lines by clicking "Ctrl+A":
Step 3: Click on Change Records and select the Manual Discount% and enter the field value to be updated for all line items and then click OK:
Step 4: After clicking OK on Change records applet, the editable field in which user clicked in step 1 is changed :
RCA: Change Records is a Siebel Vanilla functionality where it is observed that above steps in all quote line items leads to changing the value in initially selected editable fields. This phenomenon can be observed in other editable fields as well:
Also this is not limited to Service Quotes only, we have replicated the same steps on parts quote too. 
This is a Siebel bug where the change record functionality is behaving in this manner. Current business process configuration is correct but this issue is arising because of the existing Siebel bug, 
Countermeasure: We should inform the users of Hakodate branch to perform such operations on read only fields so that such occurrence can be avoided. Users can click on read only fields or instead of selecting all the fields at once by ctrl+A they can select the records manually(If the cursor is at an editable field). This will ensure that such issue do not occur again. 
Since no further topic is pending on this Jira, kindly allow us to close this ticket. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

We have checked this issue and found that JV is created on the basis of Flag in D2S Invoice, if any record is found where flag is is not "S" then JV is created. This issue occurred only for those cases where PO Number(X_ATTRIB_02) is null.

We have checked the discrepancy in logic why flag was not updated to "S" even after JV was created, as per existing logic, Flag is updated for those records where *(PO Num and Invoice Num and Inv Dt)* is not null. We will update this filter condition to not check if it is null.
Only 3 records have been found and only on Chugoku. So please confirm if it is normal for PO Num to be null, if it is then we will update the filter condition after your confirmation

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated the root cause and found that the sorting in the Journal Voucher is performed in the order of *Timestamp > Global Order Number > Data Set Separator*. Since both the timestamp and Global Order Number are the same in these cases, the grouping is being done based on the Data Set Separator.
This issue is very rare and has occurred only for a few records in Okayama.
M000204765
 M000244090
 M000303799
 M000315069
 M000364233
 M000401254
 M000433410
 M000442591

 As discussed, implementing a fix would require significant changes to the existing logic. Therefore, we kindly request you to close this Jira once recovery has been completed for all affected records.
We will continue to monitor the system daily and perform recovery if any similar cases are detected in the future.
Please let us know if you have any questions or concerns.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav

Thanks for your support.
Please find below the updates:
*Issue*: The issue related to the Status Code difference between the SC and FDP environments. *RCA*: The reason for this difference is that the data is coming from different source tables in both SC and FDPs. 
In FDP, the Status Code is coming from the WC_SERVICE_ORDER_F table, which means it is showing the Order Status and In SC, the Status Code is coming from the W_SRVREQ_MD table, which means it is showing the Service Request Status. 
Thus, The values in Status code filters are different in both SC and FDP.
Best Regards,
Deepika

RCA: we have the logic in PBI reports for status column:
If the sub_status is "stocked in", then it will be shown as 本入庫 whereas if the status is not "Stocked in" then whatever will be the status, It will always shown as "商品".

comments.author: Soham Modi
comments.text:
さん
いつもお世話になっております。
FDP UAT環境にて対象機能の動作確認を実施し、すべてのテストケースが正常に完了したことを確認いたしました。また、事象の再現は確認できませんでした。
あわせて、FDP本番環境全体についても調査を実施しましたが、同様の事象が発生しているレコードは確認されませんでした。
本件の対象データはGo liveの時に移行されたものであり、事象のご報告までに時間が経過していたため、調査に必要なシステムログの保存期間を超過しており、該当ログを取得することができませんでした。そのため、システムの動作および取得可能なログを確認いたしましたが、情報が不十分のため、根本原因の分析や再発防止策の実施を行うことはできかねます。
今後、同様の事象への対応をより適切に行うため、システムログの保存期間を現在の1か月から2か月へ延長する予定です。これにより、保存期間内にご報告いただいた事象については、より詳細な調査を実施し、適切な再発防止策を講じることが可能となります。
また、本件につきましては、本日ITチームを含めて会議を設定おりますので、相談させていただきます。
ご不明な点やご質問等がございましたら、お気軽にご連絡ください。
何卒よろしくお願いいたします。
マニシャ
（ENU）
Tsunoda San
Thank you for your continued support.
We have thoroughly tested the functionality in the FDP UAT environment, and all test cases passed successfully. The issue could not be reproduced. We also checked all FDP Production environments and confirmed that no other records with a similar issue were found.
As this record was migrated during go live time and the issue was reported much later, the relevant system logs were no longer available. We reviewed the system functionality and all available logs; however, there was insufficient information to perform a root cause analysis or implement preventive measures.
To avoid this situation in the future, we plan to extend the system log retention period from *one month* to *two months*. This will allow us to investigate similar incidents more effectively if they are reported within that period and implement appropriate preventive actions.
In addition, we will arrange a meeting with you and the IT team to discuss this in more detail.
Please let us know if you have any questions or require any additional information.
Regards
Manisha

comments.author: aina Sun
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-San,
いつもお世話になっております。
本件について、調査結果をご報告いたします。
■ 事象
NV受注において、納車承認時にエラーが発生しました。
■ RCA（原因）
本エラーは、NV受注に「約束手形期日（Promissory Note Due Date）」が登録されていなかったことにより発生しました。一方で、同項目はNV見積には正しく登録されていました。
対象データはSC本番環境から移行されたレコードであるため、SC本番環境を確認したところ、当該項目はNV受注・NV見積の両方に正しく登録されていることを確認しております。
移行後はNV見積には正しくデータが反映されていましたが、データ移行時の何らかの不整合により、NV受注には当該項目が登録されなかったものと考えております。
ご懸念は十分理解しておりますが、データ移行は約1年前に実施されており、現時点ではSiebel側から、本事象がデータ移行時の手動作業等に起因するものであったかどうかを特定することはできません。
また、本事象は今回の移行データ1件のみで確認されており、他の移行データや新規作成データでは同様の事象は確認されておりません。
調査の結果、現在のアプリケーションロジックに起因する問題ではないと判断しており、今後新たに作成されるデータで同様の事象が発生する可能性は低いと考えております。
現時点では、本件についてこれ以上調査を継続したり、本データ不整合の正確な原因を特定したりするための追加情報や証跡はございません。
何卒ご理解賜りますようお願い申し上げます。
よろしくお願いいたします。
(English)
Thank you for your support.
Please find details regarding this issue:
Issue description: Delivery Approval error appeared in NV SO.
RCA: This delivery Approval error occurred because Promissory Note Due Date was not present in NV Sales Order. However, this date was present in NV Sales Quote. Since this is a migrated record from SC Prod, we checked and confirm that this date is present in both NV sales order and NV sales quote in SC Prod environment.
This date was correctly migrated in NV Sales Quote however we believe that due to some data migration discrepancy, the date field was not populated in NV Sales Order.
We understand your concern. However, since the data migration was carried out approximately one year ago, it is unfortunately not possible from the Siebel side to determine at this stage whether this issue originated from a manual operation performed during the migration process.
Additionally, this issue has been identified only in this particular migrated record, and we have not observed any similar cases in other migrated or newly created records. Based on our investigation, we believe this is not related to the current application logic, and therefore a similar issue is unlikely to occur in future records.
At this point, no further information or evidence is available that would enable us to continue the investigation or determine the exact cause of this specific data inconsistency.
We appreciate your understanding in this matter.
Regards,
Sunaina Gill

After the migration, the data was correctly reflected in the NV quotation, but we believe that due to some inconsistency during the data migration, the item in question was not registered in the NV order.

As a result of our investigation, we have determined that the problem is not caused by the current application logic, and we believe that it is unlikely that a similar phenomenon will occur with newly created data in the future.
At this time, we do not have any additional information or evidence to continue investigating this matter or determine the exact cause of this data inconsistency.
Thank you for your understanding.

comments.author: Soham Modi
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda San,
いつもお世話になっております。
Hoshinoさんからのご質問について回答いたしましたので、以下の内容をご確認ください。
1．データ移行により、なぜ見積と受注の間でデータ不整合が発生したのか
対象レコードはSC本番環境から移行された古いデータであり、移行から長期間が経過しております。そのため、移行時に発生した不整合の正確な原因を特定することは困難です。
ただし、全ての受注データを確認した結果、本事象が発生していたのは当該1件のみであり、他の本番環境を含めて影響を受けているレコードは存在しないことを確認しております。
2．なぜ見積と受注の不整合により受注完了処理ができなくなるのか
本件では、見積には「約束手形期日」が設定されていましたが、対応する受注には当該項目が設定されていませんでした。
受注完了処理時には、見積と受注の重要項目について整合性チェックが実施されます。本件ではその不整合が検知されたため、受注完了処理が正常に停止しました。
なお、このような不整合を検知するためのバリデーション機能は設計どおり正常に動作しております。
現時点では、これ以上の詳細調査を実施するための追加情報はございません。
また、本事象について再現性がないことを確認しており、FDPにおいて今後新規作成されるレコードで同様の問題が発生することはないと判断しております。
システム機能は正常に動作しておりますので、本チケットのクローズをご承認いただけますようお願いいたします。
よろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Dear Tsunoda San,
Thank you for your continued support.
We have answered the question from Mr. Hoshino, so please check the following.
1. Why did data inconsistency occur between quotations and orders due to data migration?
The target record is old data migrated from the SC production environment, and a long period of time has passed since the migration. Therefore, it is difficult to determine the exact cause of inconsistencies that occur during migration.
However, after checking all order data, we have confirmed that this event occurred in only one case, and that there are no other records affected, including those in the production environment.
2. Why is it impossible to complete an order due to a discrepancy between the estimate and the order?
In this case, a "promissory note due date" was set in the quotation, but the corresponding item was not set in the corresponding order.
During the order completion process, a consistency check is performed on important items in the quotation and order. In this case, the order completion process was stopped normally because the inconsistency was detected.
Please note that the validation function to detect such inconsistencies is working normally as designed.
At this time, we do not have any additional information to conduct further investigation.
Additionally, we have confirmed that this issue is not reproducible, and we have determined that the same issue will not occur with new records created in FDP in the future.
The system functions are operating normally, so please approve the closing of this ticket.
Thank you for your support.

We have replied to Hoshino san’s query, kindly note the following points:
1.) Why did the data inconsistency between the Quote and Sales Order occur due to the data migration?
The affected record is an old migrated record from SC Production, and a significant amount of time has passed since then. As the issue occurred a long time ago, it is not possible to accurately identify the exact cause of the inconsistency during the migration process. However, we have reviewed all Sales Order records, and we confirm that this issue existed for only one record and there are no other impacted records across any Production environment.
2.) Why does such an inconsistency between the Quote and Sales Order prevent the order process from being completed?
The Sales Order could not be completed because the Promissory Note Due Date was present in the Quote but missing in the corresponding Sales Order. During order completion, validation checks compare critical data between the Quote and Sales Order. Since this inconsistency was detected, the validation correctly prevented the order process from being completed.
Please note that the validation logic designed to detect such inconsistencies is functioning as expected.
Please note at this point we do not have any additional information to carry out further analysis. But we confirm that this issue is not replicable and will not occur in any future records in FDP. 
The functionality is working correctly. Kindly allow us to close this ticket.
Regards
Sunaina Gill

comments.text:
角田様
 ご支援ありがとうございます。
 ご懸念の件、承知いたしました。問題の原因は、添付スクリーンショットでハイライトされている「約束手形支払期日」フィールドの空白値によるものです：
Please find the below details on this Jira ticket: 
|説明|ユーザーは「約束手形支払期日」フィールドの値が空白であるため、配送承認エラーが発生しました。|
|根本原因分析（RCA）|「約束手形支払期日」フィールドの値がNV見積書に入力されましたが、この値はNV販売注文書に存在しませんでした。このフィールドの値が空白であったため、ユーザーは納品プロセスを完了できませんでした。|
|回復状況|影響を受けたレコードの復旧が完了しました。|
|修正計画|中国プロダクション上の影響を受けたレコードは、移行された古いレコードであることにご留意ください。全てのテストケースシナリオに対して包括的な回帰テストを実施し、全てのテストケースが正常に通過し、期待どおりの動作を確認しました。この機能は期待どおりに動作しているため、修正は不要です。|
全FDP本番環境を調査しましたが、他の本番環境で同様の事例は確認されませんでした。現時点では、この問題は再現できず、孤立した事例であると考えられます。
 ご承認を頂ければ、このJiraチケットをクローズさせていただきたいと考えております。今後もシステムを注意深く監視し、同様の問題が発生した場合には直ちに対応いたします。

 ご質問や追加のサポートが必要な場合はお知らせください。
 よろしくお願いいたします。

comments.author: aina Sun
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
Recycle Fee Orders and Pool Cost Orders are child orders of the Chassis Order. When a Chassis Order is mapped to a Sales Order, its child orders are also mapped accordingly. In cases where duplicate child orders exist, we perform recovery for those records. The delivery approval error is occurred when line items of these duplicate records are not recovered.
Now we have recovered all duplicate purchase orders across all Prod environments. To help prevent this issue from recurring, we have also updated our AMS Recovery Manual to ensure that recovery is performed on line items of any duplicate Pool Cost Orders going forward.
Please let us know in case of any query.
Best regards,
Sunaina Gill

comments.text:
Dear  San,
Thank you for your support.
We have checked this issue and following are the root cause , impacted records, fix plan and recovery plan for this issue:
*Root Cause:*
We have found that in Re-Edit CR logic, if Re-edit button is clicked on same day as job card was created, then *Sent to KB* flag is updated to "Y" for all JVs except latest closed ones. To do this, we query using Voucher Abstract in JV, and Expense JV(Tax - Weight Tax, Tax - Automobile Type, 'Tax - Automobile Env') are created when expense is completed i.e., it is created before latest Job Card JV is created.
So sent to KB flag was getting updated to "Y".
*Fix plan:* 
We will fix this issue on UAT and exclude Job Card JVs with Order Type *'Tax - Weight Tax, Tax - Automobile Type, 'Tax - Automobile Env'.*
*Recovery Plan:*
We have checked all FDP environments and only I000213439 and I000224933 *Tax - Weight Tax JVs* were found. To recovery this we will retrigger these two JVs and it will be linked to KB in tonight's daily batch.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Regards,
Atul Yadav

Dear Tsunoda-san,

We have analyzed the issue, and please find our findings and resolution details below:
Issue: For recycle order, response from TOB side is received but not reflected in the order.
RCA: This issue occurs when duplicate recycle orders exist with the same Vehicle ID. In such cases, the TOB response is being reflected in the duplicate order instead of the correct one due to the matching Vehicle ID.

 For MS06GP-15518(Recycle Order: B000286144,Duplicate Order: B000283228)
Fix: To prevent this issue from reoccurring, we have updated our recovery procedure. Specifically, during the recovery process, the Vehicle ID is now removed from any duplicate recycle orders to ensure proper mapping of TOB responses.
 
NOTE: Recovery for such records has been completed across all production environments. The Vehicle ID has been removed from all duplicate recycle orders.

comments.author: Harsh Kumar
comments.text:
Dear  san,
いつも大変お世話になっております。
原因分析（RCA）
現在のロジックでは、納品承認前に検証チェックが行われ、部品の出荷が「未完了（Open）」の品目が存在するかどうかを確認しています。該当する出荷が存在する場合、納品承認時にバリデーションエラーメッセージが表示されます。
現在のロジックでは、「部品購入オーダー（Parts Purchase Orders）」の出荷状況がチェックされており、「部品社内オーダー（Parts Internal Orders）」は対象外となっています。
 
修正内容
本来のバリデーションの意図に合わせ、ロジックを修正し、「部品購入オーダー」ではなく「部品社内オーダー」の出荷状況をチェックするようにいたします。
これにより、キャンセルされた部品（購入オーダー）によって納品承認時にエラーが発生することを防止できます。
 
修正方針についてご確認いただき、ご不明点等ございましたらお知らせください。
 
よろしくお願い申し上げます。
comments.text_enu:
Dear san,
Thank you very much for your continued support.
Cause analysis (RCA)
The current logic is that a validation check is performed before a delivery is approved to see if there are any items that are "Open" for shipping parts. If applicable shipments exist, a validation error message will be displayed when approving the shipment.
The current logic checks the shipping status of "Parts Purchase Orders" and excludes "Parts Internal Orders."
 
Modification details
In line with the original intent of validation, we will modify the logic to check the shipping status of "internal parts orders" instead of "parts purchase orders."
This prevents canceled parts (purchase orders) from causing errors during delivery approval.
 
Please check the revision policy and let us know if you have any questions.
 
Thank you for your support.

comments.author: Soham Modi
comments.text:
Dear san,
 
Thank you for your support, and apologies for the inconvenience. Your understanding is correct.
 
*RCA*:
In the current logic, Before delivery approval a validation check is applied which checks if shipment of any parts line item is Open or not. If such shipments are found then Validation message occurs on Delivery Approval. According to the current logic, shipment of Parts Purchase Orders are checked rather then Parts Internal Order. 
 
*Fix*:
To align with the validation, we will update the logic to check shipment of Parts Internal Order rather then Parts Purchase Order. This will ensure that no such cancelled parts(with Purchase Orders) cause error in Delivery Approval.
 
Kindly confirm our fix plan and let us know if you have any query.
 
Best Regards,
Soham

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
Dear  San,
Thank you for your support and cooperation.
The problem earlier was failure in generation of BIP report (Order Detail) generated after getting the Sales Order approved.
 This problem was occurring because the user might have entered the last contract date someday before the year 2020. 
 For example 09/10/2018. This field in editable so later on the user might have corrected it after sales order approval.
 This back date of 09/10/2018 was leading to fetching of null value in tax rate. This tax rate is calculated in the basis of last contract date by comparing it to the Start and End date of the Tax Value in the Tax Master table. The start date in the table is a day of year 2020. So entering a date before this day will lead to failure in BIP generation.
 We are attaching the issue replication steps. Following these steps, earlier their was issue of failure in BIP generation but now there will not be an issue anymore.
 
Please let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
 Saad

HelloPlease find the below mentioned details of the issue.
*1.Root Cause:*
Timeout parameter was changed from 1 hour to 2 hours, which led to extended user sessions during peak load, amplifying memory leaks in the system.
*2. Technical Observation:*
During peak traffic, prolonged sessions resulted in higher memory utilization and session retention at web layer.
*3. Oracle / Siebel Recommendation:*
As per Oracle and Siebel best practices, timeout synchronization between web and application layers must be maintained. Setting a long timeout value is not recommended due to possible performance impact.
*4. Action Taken:*
Timeout parameter was reverted from 2 hours back to 1 hour. Post-change, system stability was restored.
*5. Countermeasure / Preventive Action:*
For any future requirement to extend the session time, it is advised to increase the timeout parameter gradually (e.g., in 10-minute intervals) and monitor system stability after each change.
*6. Future Plan:*
If performance instability persists even after gradual adjustment, infrastructure-level tuning will be considered to ensure long-term system stability.
Thank you.
Please let us know in case of some further query.

comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
 We have thoroughly investigated and this issue is same as MFTBCFFR-4243.
 *User Steps:*
 In Revision 1, the Trade-In Flag in NV Quote Header was selected as “Y”.
 However in revision 2, user manually unchecked the flag, changing it to “N”.
 If a user intends to delete the Trade-In Assessment, the correct process is to delete the assessment record first and then uncheck the Trade-In flag.
 *RCA:*
 When the Trade-In flag is unchecked in the NV Quote header, the related Trade-In fields become read-only. This prevents deletion, as certain backend field updates required during deletion cannot occur in this state.
 *Recovery Plan:*
 No recovery action is required. The user can resolve the issue by rechecking the Trade-In flag to “Y”. This will allow deletion of the Trade-In Assessment as needed.
Conclusion:
 This is a case of user mis operation, not a system defect. Hence, kindly allow us to reject this incident.
 Please advise the user to follow the steps outlined above. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
Regards,
 Atul Yadav

Dear Tsunoda さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
添付資料のとおり、部門種別コード（Division Type Code） は、実際にはユーザーのポジションに紐づく組織タイプ（Organization Type） を参照しております。
中国環境を確認したところ、持ち込み後付オーダーは添付資料に記載の3つの組織に所属するポジションのユーザーによって作成されておりました。
一方で、「11SC」組織に所属するポジションから作成された持ち込み後付オーダーはありませんでした。
そのため、ODI処理では部門種別コードとして**「11SC」**を条件に検索していたため、対象の受注を取得できず、ステータスが更新されなかったことが本事象の原因です。
ご不明な点や追加で必要な情報がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。

On the other hand, there were no carry-on retroactive orders created from positions belonging to the "11SC" organization.
Therefore, in ODI processing, the department type code was searched using **"11SC"**, so the target order could not be obtained and the status was not updated, which is the cause of this event.

持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）に対応するD21Zファイルを受信し、実際完了日（106桁目から4文字が「J」で始まるデータ）が設定されている場合、対象の持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）のステータスは**「完了済み（Completed）」**に更新される仕様となっております。
 
調査の結果、ステータスが「完了済み（Completed）」に更新されなかった原因は、ODI処理において受注のコードを**「11SC」で検索していたためでした。一方、FDPでは対象受注のコードが「本部（Headquarters）」**で作成されているため、条件が一致せず、ステータス更新が行われていませんでした。
 
本事象はODI処理の設定に起因するものであり、現在は対象ファイルに必要な修正を実施しております。これにより、今後は持ち込み後付シャーシオーダー（Retro-fit Chassis Order）について同様の事象は発生しない見込みです。
 
以上が本件の原因となります。
 
内容をご確認いただき、ご不明な点がございましたらお気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。
 
(English)
Thank you for your support and cooperation.
We have completed our analysis for this issue and would like to share with you the root cause of this issue.
Whenever we receive the D21Z file for any corresponding “Retro-fit Chassis Order“ with Actual Completion Dates ( Starting with the character J at position 106 upto 4 Characters ). The Retrofit Chassis Order’s status should change to ‘Completed'.
As of now, the orders were not getting their Statuses set to "Completed" because the search command was matching the Order’s Division Type Code with ‘11SC', however in FDP, the orders are created with their Division Type Codes as ‘Headquarters’.
Due to this mismatch the Orders were not getting their Statuses updated. This issue is related to the ODI executions. We have implemented the required changes in the respective files. We hope the issue will not occur for any Retrofit Orders in the future.
We request you to please review the above RCA and let us know in case of any query.
Best Regards,
Saad

Dear San,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
We have completed our investigation into this issue and would like to report the cause (RCA).
 
When a D21Z file corresponding to a Retro-fit Chassis Order is received and the actual completion date (data starting with "J" starting from the 106th digit) is set, the status of the Retro-fit Chassis Order will be updated to **Completed**.
 
As a result of our investigation, the reason why the status was not updated to "Completed" was because the code of the order was searched for ** "11SC" during ODI processing. On the other hand, in FDP, the code for the target order was created in "Headquarters"**, so the conditions did not match and the status was not updated.
 
This issue is caused by the ODI processing settings, and we are currently making the necessary corrections to the target file. As a result, we do not expect similar incidents to occur regarding Retro-fit Chassis Orders in the future.
 
The above is the cause of this issue.
 
Please check the contents and feel free to contact us if you have any questions.
 
Thank you for your support.

Dear Tsunoda-san,
Thank you for your support.
Issue:
Previously, when the D21F file was processed multiple times for the same dealer, duplicate recycle fee orders were created for the same chassis order. The number of recycle fee orders generated matched the number of times the file was processed, resulting in duplicate recycle orders.
Fix Implemented:
We have updated the recycle fee order creation logic and with this enhancement, once a recycle fee order is created for a chassis order under a specific dealer code, subsequent processing of the same D21F file will no longer generate duplicate recycle fee orders.
Result:
Only one recycle fee order will be created for each chassis order, ensuring that duplicate recycle fee orders are no longer generated.
We kindly request your approval for the Fix plan.
Please let us know if any additional information is required from our side.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi

comments.text:
Thank you for your continued support.
We have investigated the root cause of the issue and found that the department code was not set to "TB" for the UV Purchase Order in the following cases:
 # *"MAP: Red Slip" Case*:
 In this scenario, the department code is hardcoded to "0000". As a result, regardless of the sales representative's department, the system always assigns "0000" for this Journal Event Type.
 # *"PO - AP Posting UV Sales Order" Case*:
 In this case, both the MF Sales Rep Branch Code and the X_ORDER_ID column are null. According to the existing logic, if the MF Sales Rep Branch Code is null, "INTERNAL", or "Default Organization", the department code is set as "0000". Since the  "MF Sales Rep Branch Code" is null for the mentioned order, the department code was set as "0000" in Journal Voucher.
We are currently replicating this issue in the UAT environment and will inform you of the fix plan as soon as replication is complete. In the meantime, please confirm recovery and let us know if you have any questions or need further clarification.
Thanks & Regards,
Atul Yadav

いつも大変お世話になっております。
 
本件につきまして原因を調査した結果、以下のケースにおいて、UV購入注文の部署コードが「TB」として設定されていないことが判明しました。
 
「MAP: Red Slip」ケース：
このケースでは、部署コードが「0000」にハードコーディングされており、どの営業担当者の部署であっても、この仕訳イベントタイプの場合は常に「0000」が設定される仕様となっています。
 
「PO - AP Posting UV Sales Order」ケース：

Thank you very much for your continued support.
 
After investigating the cause of this issue, we discovered that in the following cases, the department code for UV purchase orders was not set as "TB".
 
"MAP: Red Slip" case:
In this case, the department code is hard-coded to ``0000,'' and the specification is that it will always be set to ``0000'' for this journal event type, regardless of the salesperson's department.
 
"PO - AP Posting UV Sales Order" case:
In this case, the MF salesperson's branch code and X_ORDER_ID columns were both null. In the existing logic, if the MF sales representative's branch code is null, "INTERNAL", or "Default Organization", the department code is set to "0000". Since the branch code was null for the relevant order, "0000" was set in the journal entry slip.
 
We are currently reproducing this issue in a UAT environment and will provide a fix plan once the reproduction is complete.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please check the recovery. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us.
 
Thank you for your support.
Himanshu

会議でのご説明に基づき、これはUAT環境で修正済みとなっており、ご承認をいただき次第、開発内容を9日のリリースで本番環境へリリースいたします。
 
「確定報告 - Send Recycle Fee Button」の有効／無効の条件について、以下の通りとなっております。
 
【ボタンが無効となるTOBステータス】
 
TOBに提出済
 
【ボタンが無効となるリサイクル料金注文ステータス】
 
完了（Completed）
修正中（Recycle Change In Progress）
修正完了（Recycle Order Changed）
CUT中（Recycle Cancel Pending）
 
【ボタンが有効となるリサイクル料金注文ステータス】
 
作成中（Pending）
キャンセル（Cancelled）
 
TOBステータスが「TOBに提出済」と異なる場合
リサイクル料金注文のステータスが「保留中」または「キャンセル済」で、かつTOBステータスが「TOB成功」または「TOBエラー」の場合は、ボタンが有効なままになります。
 
ご確認のほどよろしくお願いいたします。ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
Best Regards,
 Saad Ahmed
comments.text_enu:
thank you always.
 
Based on the explanation at the meeting, this has been fixed in the UAT environment, and once we receive your approval, we will release the development content to the production environment on the 9th.
 
The conditions for enabling/disabling the "Confirmation Report - Send Recycle Fee Button" are as follows.
 
[TOB status where button is disabled]
 
Submitted to TOB
 
[Recycling fee order status where the button is disabled]
 
Completed
Recycle Change In Progress
Modification completed (Recycle Order Changed)
CUT in progress (Recycle Cancel Pending)
 
[Recycling fee order status where the button is enabled]
 
Creating (Pending)
Cancelled
 
If the TOB status is different from "Submitted to TOB"
If the recycling fee order status is "Pending" or "Cancelled" and the TOB status is "TOB Successful" or "TOB Error", the button remains enabled.
 
Thank you for your confirmation. If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.
Best Regards,
 Saad Ahmed

Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
We have successfully replicated the issue in the UAT1 environment. Please refer to the following record: Sales Quote: 1-6FHJ0C, Opportunity: 1-6FHIYB
Upon investigation, we found that the Model Code was manually removed from the Vehicle. As a result, line items are not being created in the UV Quote. This appears to be a case of user misoperation.
To resolve the issue, kindly advise the user to take the following steps:
1.) Delete the Vehicle from the UV Opportunity.
2.) Add the appropriate Model Code to the Vehicle.
3.) Re-map the Vehicle to the UV Opportunity.
4.) Proceed to create the Quote from the Opportunity.
Please let us know if you have any questions or need further assistance.
Best regards,
Sunaina Gill

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
We have checked this issue and found that there is some discrepancy in the filter of following Journal Event types:
*"*
 *Service Correction Sales Amount Non-Taxable*
 *Service Correction Sales Amount Red Slip Non-Taxable*
 *Service Purchase CT*
 *Re-Edit Red Slip Job Card Sales Amount Non-Taxable*
 *Job Card Sales Amount Taxable*
 *ConsTax PO - UV Body Building Order*
 *ConsTax PO - Body Building Order - Non IBOS*
 *"*
The records you have provided was created before this fix was released. Also, we have checked all Journal Types where Zero amount JV is getting created and enlisted above are JVs where the field used in the filter is different from the Base Amount field in JV. 
To fix this issue we will use same fields in filter as in "Credit Base Amount" and "Debit Base Amount" fields. As of our understanding Zero amount JV is not processed on KB side so no recovery is required in this.
Please check and approve the fix plan , we will fix it on uat once we get approval from you.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav

comments.text:
Thanks for your support.

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
Thanks for your support. 
This filter is used at the time of JV creation on "Base Amount" field of journal voucher where we check if value of this field is not equal to zero, if it is zero JV will not be created. In earlier release, we fixed this issue for the case issue that was reported.
The problem is not occurring for other Journal Event types above, and zero amount JV was not reported for all other cases that we have mentioned for that specific case after the 12th June release. 
Since we have found some cases for this issue again we checked all JVs where this issue has occurred in recent times, we will fix it for all the cases where filter is incorrect, we will use base amount field logic which will prevent this issue.
We will provide you the data you asked by today end of day.
Please let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav

comments.author: Atul Yadav
comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
We have checked all FDP prod and found that Zero amount Journal Voucher is getting created for the earlier mentioned Journal Event types. Please find attached the Journal Voucher data . 
To fix this issue we will add the "Base amount not equal to zero" in the filter at the time of JV creation.
Please approve the proposed fix and we will fix this issue by 23rd July 2025.

Best regards,
Atul Yadav

転送機能に関してご報告いたします。

以上の点を踏まえ、現在のテスト方法は正しく、システムは正常に動作していることをご報告申し上げます。

We would like to inform you about the transfer function. 
+Currently, the organization is set up as follows:+
D0X20851's affiliated organization: Okayama Higashi Branch (10)
D0X20852's affiliated organization: Default Organization "000000000O"
 
According to the backend logic, to transfer positions between users, both users must belong to the same organization. Therefore, in the current situation where D0X20851 and D0X20852 belong to different organizations, the "Forward" function is working as expected.
 
If you change one user (D0X20851 or D0X20852) to the same organization as the other, you can transfer to any user and position.
 
Note that clicking the Transfer button will display the positions associated with the current user, but only if they are in the same organization.

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
In UV Quotes, it is possible to change status from "Approved" to "Order Intake". After status is "Order Intake", user can not set the status again to "Approved", this is a blocker in business process. 
Fix Plan: As a fix for this bug, we will restrict the change of status by making it read only for UV Quotes. If user need to change the status manually, we can also restrict status change from "Approved" to "Order Intake". Kindly confirm which fix plan to be applied for this bug.
Recovery: Recovery is completed for the given record.
Kindly confirm the fix plan and let us know if you have any query or need any additional detail.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

いつも大変お世話になっております。
 
本件について詳細に調査を行い、以下のとおり調査結果をご報告いたします。
 
■調査結果
 UV見積において、「Approved」ステータスから「Order Intake」ステータスへの変更は可能ですが、「Order Intake」になった後に再度「Approved」へ戻すことはできません。
 この挙動がビジネスプロセス上の支障となっています。
 
■修正案
 この不具合に対する対応として、以下いずれかの方法でステータス変更を制限する修正を検討しております。
 
UV見積において、ステータス変更を全体的に読み取り専用（Read Only）にする
 
「Approved」→「Order Intake」へのステータス変更のみ制限する
 
どちらの修正案を適用すべきか、ご確認・ご指示いただけますと幸いです。
 
■リカバリー
 該当レコードに対するリカバリーは完了しております。
 
修正方針についてご確認のうえ、ご不明点や追加のご要望がございましたらお知らせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。

Thank you very much for your continued support.
 
We have conducted a detailed investigation into this matter and will report the findings as follows.
 
■Survey results
 In UV quotation, it is possible to change the status from "Approved" to "Order Intake", but once it becomes "Order Intake", it is not possible to change it back to "Approved" again.
 This behavior is a hindrance to business processes.
 
■Revision proposal
 As a response to this issue, we are considering a fix that would restrict status changes using one of the following methods.
 
Make status changes globally read-only in UV estimates
 
Restrict only status changes from "Approved" to "Order Intake"
 
We would appreciate it if you could confirm and instruct us which amendment should be applied.
 
■Recovery
