Thank you very much for your continued support.
 
The duplicate issue has been corrected in MFTBCFFR-3809, and the bodywork order you contacted has also been restored.
 
Only two cases, B033646702 and B034169101 (JV created on February 7, 2024), were confirmed to be duplicates after applying the fix for MFTBCFFR-3809.
For this reason, we previously announced that only one duplicate occurred.
 
In addition, the JV creation operation is controlled to prevent the same JV from being created twice even if the user manually changes the status.
Furthermore, we have added search conditions (Search Specification) to responses from IBOS.
 
In testing in the UAT environment, no duplicate JVs were observed.
Therefore, we will continue to monitor and investigate the routes and conditions under which duplicate JVs are being created in the production environment.
 
We are currently investigating possible causes and will update you as soon as the cause is determined.
 
Thank you for your support.

comments.author: Divyesh Ghiya
comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this incident and below are our findings:
 For the fix of MFTBCFFR-3809 Incident, we added a Validation check where if Journal Voucher of the Body Building Order already exist then no additional trigger of Journal Voucher will be created. But in this check, condition used to search for existing Journal Voucher needs to be improved. 
 Currently, our Validation checks that if a Completed Trigger exist for that Body Building Order, but we need to update the condition to: if a trigger with any status exist then we will not create another JV trigger. 
 Duplicated Journal Voucher was created after 2 minutes of original Journal Voucher, our validation checked for Completed trigger but since original trigger was not completed at that time, another duplicate trigger was sent. We need to update our check so that if any trigger exist for Original Journal Voucher than no duplicate Journal Voucher will be created. 
This will resolve duplicate Journal Voucher issue.
Kindly check and approve our fix plan.
Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional detail.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

いつも大変お世話になっております。
このインシデントを分析した結果、以下の通りご報告いたします。
 
MFTBCFFR-3809 インシデントの修正対応として、架装オーダーに対して既に仕訳伝票が存在する場合は、新たな仕訳伝票トリガーを作成しないよう、バリデーションチェックを追加しました。
しかしながら、既存の仕訳伝票を検索する際の条件に改善の余地があることが判明しました。
 
現在のバリデーションでは、「完了済み」のトリガーが存在するかどうかのみをチェックしていますが、今後は「ステータスに関係なく、いずれかのトリガーが存在する場合」は新たな仕訳伝票トリガーを作成しないように条件を変更する必要があります。
 
今回、重複した仕訳伝票は、元の仕訳伝票の2分後に作成されました。バリデーションは「完了済み」のトリガーのみを確認していたため、元のトリガーがまだ完了していなかった時点で、別のトリガーが送信されてしまいました。
 
したがって、今後は「元の仕訳伝票に対するいかなるトリガーが存在する場合でも」重複する仕訳伝票が作成されないようにバリデーションを修正いたします。
 
この修正により、重複仕訳伝票の問題は解消される見込みです。
 
修正案のご確認とご承認をお願いいたします。
ご不明点や追加情報が必要な場合は、お知らせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Thank you very much for your continued support.
As a result of analyzing this incident, we would like to report the following.
 
MFTBCFFR-3809 To correct the incident, a validation check has been added to prevent creating a new journal entry trigger if a journal entry slip already exists for a bodywork order.
However, it was found that there was room for improvement in the conditions for searching existing journal entry vouchers.
 
In the current validation, we only check whether a "Completed" trigger exists, but in the future, we will need to change the condition to not create a new journal entry trigger if any trigger exists, regardless of the status.
 
This time, the duplicate journal entry voucher was created two minutes after the original journal entry voucher. Validation only checked for "completed" triggers, which resulted in another trigger being sent before the original one had completed yet.
 
Therefore, in the future, we will correct the validation so that duplicate journal vouchers are not created "even if any trigger exists for the original journal voucher."
 
This correction is expected to resolve the issue of duplicate journal entry vouchers.
 
Please review and approve the proposed amendment.
If you have any questions or need additional information, please let us know.
 
Thank you for your support.

Thank you for your support. 
 
 We have thoroughly investigated and below are our findings:
 
 *User Steps:*
 * In Revision 2 and Revision 3, the UV Trade-In Flag in UV Quote Header was selected as “Y”.
 * However, in Revision 4, the user manually unchecked the flag, changing it to “N”.
If a user intends to delete the UV Trade-In Assessment, the correct process is to delete the assessment record first and then uncheck the UV Trade-In flag.
*RCA:*
When the UV Trade-In flag is unchecked in the UV Quote header, the related Trade-In fields become read-only. This prevents deletion, as certain backend field updates required during deletion cannot occur in this state.
Recovery Plan:
No recovery action is required. The user can resolve the issue by rechecking the UV Trade-In flag to “Y”. This will allow deletion of the UV Trade-In Assessment as needed.
 
*Conclusion:*
This is a case of user mis operation, not a system defect. Hence, kindly allow us to reject this incident.
Please advise the user to follow the steps outlined above. Please let us know if you have any query or need any additional support.
 
 Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

Dear Tsunoda-san,
 
Thank you very much for your continued support.
 
Regarding the issue raised, we have identified it as a case of user mis-operation. In Revision 1 of Quote 1-8OC74, the line item for 自動車税（種別割）was listed with a tax value of ¥8,600. At that stage, only the Sales Order and Invoice were created based on this revision.
 
Subsequently, in Revision 2 of the quote, the user updated the tax value for the same line item to ¥9,700. However, the Registration Request was created after this revision and derived its values from the existing invoice, which was originally generated based on Revision 1. As a result, the tax value reflected in the Registration Request remains ¥8,600.
 
To correct this, the appropriate action would have been for the user to generate a new invoice(has to cancel the existing invoice) after updating the tax value in Revision 2 of the quote.
 
Please let us know if any further clarification is needed.
 
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you very much for your support.
Recovery has been completed for the affected record.
We have replicated the issue in the UAT1 environment. Please find the details below:
Reference Record for UAT1
NV SO#: A001295706
PO#: F001295707
AR#: H000047991 (Assessment Purpose: User Purchase)
Upon investigation, we found that an Assessment Request with the assessment purpose set as ‘User Purchase’ can be directly mapped to an NV Quote as a Trade-in Vehicle. This is why the user was able to map the UV Purchase Order to the NV Sales Order.
As a countermeasure, we plan to implement a code change in the process of adding a trade-in vehicle to the NV Quote. After the change, users will only be able to map assessments in NV Quote related to Trade-in assessment purposes only.
Please let us know if you have any concerns or suggestions regarding this approach.
Thank you and best regards,
Sunaina Gill

comments.text:
角田様
お待たせして申し訳ございません。
以下に、調査結果と今後の対応方針をご案内いたします。
問題は何ですか？
 → IBOSの見積回答が反映されない。
 原因は何ですか？
 → 本件の問題は、既存のデータマップ（バックエンド）における操作設定が「update（更新）」となっていたことに起因しています。この設定では既存レコードの変更のみが可能であるため、IBOSのレスポンスに含まれる新規の架装レコードが作成されませんでした。
 どのように修正しましたか？
 → データマップ（バックエンド）の操作設定を「update（更新）」から「upsert」に変更しました。これにより、IBOSのレスポンスに基づいて既存レコードは更新されるとともに、新規の架装レコードも必要に応じて作成されるようになります。
7月30日にUAT2上でSOAPを通じてIBOSからのレスポンスを生成することで、この問題をどのようにテストできるかをお見せするためのミーティングを、お客様のご都合に合わせて調整いたします。ミーティングのスケジュールについてご都合の良い日時をお知らせいただき、ご質問がありましたらお知らせください。
 
 Thanks & Regards,
 Atul Yadav
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda
We apologize for keeping you waiting.
Below, we will inform you of the results of the investigation and our future response policy.
What is the problem?
 → IBOS's estimate response is not reflected.
 What is the cause?
 → This issue is due to the operation setting in the existing data map (backend) being set to "update". Since this setting only allows modification of existing records, no new bodywork records were created to be included in the IBOS response.
 How did you fix it?
 → Changed the data map (backend) operation setting from "update" to "upsert". This allows existing records to be updated based on IBOS responses, and new bodywork records to be created as needed.
We will arrange a meeting at your convenience on July 30th to show you how you can test this issue by generating a response from IBOS through SOAP on UAT2. Please let us know what time and date is convenient for you to schedule the meeting, and let us know if you have any questions.
 
 Thanks & Regards,
 Atul Yadav

Dear Tsunoda-san,
 Thank you for your continued support.
We have completed our analysis regarding the reported issue in the JIRA ticket. We successfully replicated the issue in the UAT environment using the reference record NV Quote #: 1-KHY8Z, Rev-3, and confirmed that this is a case of user misoperation.
 Here are the steps the user followed that led to the issue:
 1.) In NV Quote #: 1-IQZEL, Rev-2, the user added a trade-in vehicle with AR#: H000001601.
 2.) While creating Rev-3, the user removed the AR# from the trade-in vehicle line item and then deleted the record.
 3.) Subsequently, the user added a new trade-in vehicle with AR#: H000001602.
As a result of this sequence, the asset_id in the trade-in line item was cleared, leading to the display of a blank line item in the NV Quote.
 To avoid this issue, we suggest the user to delete the existing trade-in line item entirely and then, create a new line item with the desired trade-in vehicle information or to change the AR# directly without erasing it.
Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions or need further assistance.
Best regards,
Sunaina Gill

Currently, the "Customer Name" in the API is set based on the "Ship To Customer Name" in the JC header, but we have recently changed the mapping of the "CustomerName" tag in the FDP UAT-1 environment.

comments.author: Divyesh Ghiya
comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have analyszed this issue thorughly and below are our findings:
 On 6th February, User changed the closing of the mentioned account from 20 to EOM. 
Since, Bulk Invoice logic includes only 30 days of data, this data was not sent in February EOM. 
 These orders were supposed to be sent to KB on 20th closing, but user changed the closing from 20 to EOM. Now in Feb EOM, this data is supposed to be sent to KB but since Bulk Invoice logic only includes data of last 30 days, 20th Jan to 28th Jan data was not sent to KB. 
This is not a system bug, during initial development of the Bulk Invoice functionality, only 30 days range was included. There is a ongoing CR where we will change this range from 30 days to 60 days. By this CR, such cases will be avoided. 
Kindly verify our analysis and please let us know if you have any query or need any additional information.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

This issue has been raised on 19th May at 9:46 AM JST.

いつも大変お世話になっております。
 
本インシデントにつきまして分析を行った結果、リサイクル請求書データは2025年5月1日に受信されており、請求書カレンダー上の日付は2025年5月7日となっております。これは、請求書カレンダーに定められた日付よりも早くファイルが受信されたことを意味します。
 
現在の仕様では、請求書カレンダーに記載された日付と同日に受信されたファイルのみが毎月処理対象となるため、日付の不一致により、リサイクル請求書データファイルはどのFDP環境でも実行されておりません。
 
この動作は初期要件に基づくものであり、不具合ではありません。そのため、修正を行うにはAMS-CRが必要です。
 
なお、リカバリ対応として、これらのファイルを手動で処理する予定です。その際、仕訳伝票（JV）に設定すべき計上日をご確認のうえ、ご指示ください。

いつも大変お世話になっております。
以下に、ご質問いただいた内容に対する回答を記載いたします。
 
■MFTBCFFR-3040
①どのような内容のバグチケットですか？（履歴が長くてわかりません）
→ MFTBCFFR-3040 では、Miyauchi様より「KBに連携されているアカウントマスターデータの一部のカラムに誤ったマッピングがある」との報告がありました。
本件の不具合はインシデント内で修正済みですが、その後、Miyauchi様より追加開発のご要望があり、CRが必要となりました。
そのため、CRが本番環境にリリースされるまで、アカウントマスターの一括連携を停止してほしいとの依頼がありました。
 
②進捗状況を教えてください。
→ MFTBCFFR-3040 にて報告された不具合は解決済みで、修正はすべてのFDP環境に適用されています。ただし、CRの本番環境への適用はまだ未実施です。
 
※残作業はありますか？
→ はい、CRの開発および本番リリースがまだ残っています。
 
■MFTBCFFR-3149
①今時点でSIEBELからKBへの特定のアカウント情報のインターフェースを止めているのですか？
→ 現在、四国の本番環境においてアカウントマスター全体の連携を停止しています。特定のアカウントに限定した対応ではなく、すべてのアカウントに対して適用されています。
 
②①の理解が正しい場合、インターフェースを止めているアカウントコードに下記は含まれていますか？
→ アカウントコード「1000007404」は4月に作成されたものです。アカウントマスターの一括連携は4月以前にすでに停止していたため、このアカウントの情報はKBには連携されていません。
 
③①の理解が正しくない場合、具体的にどのアカウントコードについていつからいつまでインターフェースを止めていたのですか？
→ すべてのアカウントに対して、本インターフェースを停止しています。
 
ご不明な点がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-san,
After thoroughly analyzing the issue, we have determined the root cause to be that the database storage on the ODI side was completely filled at the time when these files were scheduled for execution. As a result, the files could not be executed.
To prevent this issue from occurring again in the future, the admin team has implemented an incremental storage addition mechanism. This will automatically increase the storage capacity once it reaches its limit, ensuring uninterrupted execution.
Should you have any further questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out.
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

Dear Tsunoda-san,
Thank you for your message.
We understand your point, but we would like to clarify that these chassis orders were imported from the SC environment and are identical to the orders in SC. In the SC environment, the vehicles associated with these chassis orders have a “C#” number, and all related data matches the SC records.
Please find the attached image below regarding the vehicle data in SC.
Regarding the vehicle number appearing the same as the FUSO reception number, this occurred because the D21G file—which updates the vehicle number—had not yet been executed. Until this file is processed, the vehicle number remains the same as the FUSO reception number.
Additionally, these records were created in 2024, and there is very limited information available in SC regarding the D21 files for these particular records.
We hope this clarifies the situation. Please let us know if any further explanation is needed.
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
When user creates a Payer Change Order, values in Bill to Basic Account and Ship to basic account is fetched from JCO. Then user changes the payer in Bill to Basic Account and values in Closed Date and Payment term should be reflected according to new Payer entered. Because of this, closed date was not changed to EOM (31 March) in the change order and hence not sent to KB. Since the date was 20 April, all the JC lines and change order lines were sent to KB on 20 April.
This issue is similar to MFTBCFFR-3672, So we are tracking this issue through MFTBCFFR-3672.
 Kindly allow us to close this incident.
Meanwhile, please let us know if you have any query or need any additional information.
Regards,
 Akash

san,
Thank you for your support.
We have analysed this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
While creating Journal voucher line, system checks whether the amount is equal to zero or not. Since, we do not create zero amount JV, we have added a search specification which check if the tax amount is equal to zero or not. If the tax amount is equal to zero then JV line is not created. In this case, consumption tax amount 0.8 which should be rounded to 1. But the search specification did not follow the correct rounding procedure and estimated 0.8 as 0. Hence, no JV line was created for "Job Card Sales CT" Journal event.
Fix Plan: We will fix the search specification which follows the incorrect rounding procedure. We will share the fix on UAT1 by today EOD. Please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

宮内さん、吉原さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件について詳細に調査した結果、以下のとおり判明いたしました。
仕訳伝票（JV）の明細行を作成する際、システムは金額が0であるかどうかを確認しています。金額が0の仕訳伝票を作成しない仕様となっているため、税額が0であるかどうかを判定する検索条件（Search Specification）を設定しています。税額が0の場合、仕訳伝票の明細行は作成されません。
今回のケースでは、消費税額が「0.8」であり、本来であれば四捨五入により「1」となるべきところ、検索条件内で正しい四捨五入処理が行われておらず、「0」として扱われてしまいました。その結果、「Job Card Sales CT」仕訳イベントの明細行が作成されませんでした。
対応方針：
不正確な四捨五入処理を行っている検索条件を修正いたします。本修正は本日中にUAT1環境へ反映予定です。
ご不明点等ございましたら、お気軽にお知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Miyauchi, Mr. Yoshiwara,
Thank you for your continued support.
As a result of a detailed investigation into this matter, we found the following.
When creating a journal entry (JV) line, the system checks whether the amount is 0. Since the specification is not to create journal entry slips with an amount of 0, we have set a search condition (Search Specification) to determine whether the tax amount is 0. If the tax amount is 0, no journal entry line is created.
In this case, the consumption tax amount is "0.8" and should have been rounded to "1", but the correct rounding process was not performed within the search conditions and it was treated as "0". As a result, the line for the "Job Card Sales CT" journal event was not created.
Response policy:
We will correct the search conditions that perform inaccurate rounding. This modification is scheduled to be reflected in the UAT1 environment today.
If you have any questions, please feel free to let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

Thank you for your support.
*RCA:* The issue with the incorrect Total PO Cost in the Service Purchase Order (SPO) is as per the current system logic for calculating quantity on labor line items. Specifically, for labor code '.004330', the Zero Effort Flag is set to 'Y', the Billing Type is not 'Customer', and the PO Cost Flag is 'N'. According to the current functionality, when these conditions are met, the Quantity Requested is defaulted to 1, instead of using the actual labor effort or operation time.
As a result, the Total PO Cost is calculated using the formula:
 * 1, leading to higher cost being reflected in the SPO. This behavior is functioning as designed based on existing validation rules.

吉原さん、
 いつもお世話になっております。
 原因分析（RCA）：
Service Purchase Order（SPO）における「Total PO Cost（発注合計金額）」が正しく表示されない問題は、作業項目（Labor Line Item）の数量を算出する現行のシステムロジックに起因しています。
具体的には、Laborコード '.004330' に対し、以下の条件が当てはまる場合：
Zero Effort Flag が 「Y」 に設定されている
Billing Type（請求区分） が 「Customer」以外 に設定されている
PO Cost Flag（発注原価計上フラグ） が 「N」 に設定されている
上記の条件がすべて満たされると、システムは実際の作業時間や工数にかかわらず、Quantity Requested（依頼数量） を 「1」 に自動設定します。
そのため、Total PO Cost（発注合計金額） は次の式により算出されます：× 1
このようにして、実際よりも高いコストがSPOに反映されてしまう動作は、現行のバリデーションルールに基づいた設計通りの挙動です。
なお、Zero Effort Flag を 「Y」→「N」 に変更した場合、SPO上に正しい値が反映されることを確認済みです。
添付のマスターおよびSPOのスクリーンショットをご参照ください。

よろしくお願いします。

Mr. Yoshiwara,
Thank you for your continued support.
Cause analysis (RCA):
The issue with the incorrect display of Total PO Cost on Service Purchase Orders (SPOs) is due to the current system logic for calculating Labor Line Item quantities.
Specifically, for Labor code '.004330', if the following conditions apply:
Zero Effort Flag is set to “Y”
Billing Type is set to something other than "Customer"
PO Cost Flag is set to “N”
If all the above conditions are met, the system will automatically set Quantity Requested to "1" regardless of the actual working time or effort.
Therefore, Total PO Cost (total order amount) is calculated by the following formula: × 1
This behavior, where a higher cost than the actual one is reflected in the SPO, is the designed behavior based on the current validation rules.
It has been confirmed that if the Zero Effort Flag is changed from "Y" to "N", the correct value will be reflected on SPO.
Please see the attached master and SPO screenshots.
SPO#(J001294885) screenshot: For {*JC#: I001294884*} in UAT1:
If you would like to change the current functionality, please review and let us know.
thank you.

吉原さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件について調査した結果、MFTBCFFR-3534と類似した事象であることが確認されました。
JCO#：I050019559 は、ユーザー D8TKANEM によって作成されており、作成者の Primary Branch Code は 「UG」 です。

comments.text_enu:
Mr. Yoshiwara,
Thank you for your continued support.
As a result of investigating this matter, it was confirmed that the event was similar to MFTBCFFR-3534.
JCO#: I050019559 is created by user D8TKANEM and the creator's Primary Branch Code is 'UG'.
However, the Branch Code used when issuing the individual invoice is "7331" → "UF", which does not match the creator's Primary Branch Code.
Please note that even if the Closed Date is not entered, it will not affect the issuance of individual invoices.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.author: Shivam
comments.text:
Thank you for your continued support.
We have checked the issue and found the following:
RCA: The JV for Chassis Orders is created by a Siebel Job that filter orders based on Status and Batch RF Status.
The conditions used to filter the orders are:
Status = 'Shipment Instructed'
Batch RF Status in ("Send Shipment to RF", "Send Create to RF", "")
Since the orders migrated from SC to Chugoku had Batch RF Status 'Sent to Create RF', these orders were not picked up when the Siebel Job was executed.
We have attached the list of migrated Chassis Orders along with their current status in Chugoku Production.
We will recover all the listed orders. However, as per the current logic, JV will only be created for orders with Status = 'Shipment Instructed'.
For the others, the JV will be created automatically once their status is updated to 'Shipment Instructed'.
Best Regards,
Shivam

As a result of investigating this matter, we have found that if a trigger to TOB is sent after 5:00 pm Japan time, an error is often returned from the TOB side.
However, in this case, no error was returned from the TOB side, so the re-trigger from the Siebel side was not performed the next morning, and the expected processing was not performed.
This phenomenon has been observed in multiple records across all FDP environments, and we are currently discussing with our IT team the reason why the TOB side did not return an error.
We will update you as soon as there is progress, so please wait for a while.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.author: Soham Modi
comments.text:
Thanks for your support.
Regarding this issue, when Siebel sends a request to the TOB system, we have observed scenarios where TOB does not return a response.
In the normal process flow, TOB does not accept triggers from the Siebel side after 5:00 PM JST. If a trigger is sent to TOB after 5:00 PM JST and not accepted by TOB then the corresponding records fail in the asynchronous transaction on the Siebel side. Subsequently, a Siebel batch job runs on the next day and reprocesses all failed records by resending them to TOB.
However, in this particular case, the request was accepted by TOB, and no response was received from the TOB side. As a result, the record was not identified as failed on the Siebel side and therefore was not retriggered by the batch job on the next morning as expected.
Kindly review the above and let us know the next action required from the Cubastion side.
Please let us know in case of any queries or if any additional information is required from our side.
Best Regards,
Soham Modi

comments.text:
Thanks for your continued support.
RCA: The calculation of the commission is being done when we click the "Create Spreadsheet" button in the order.
 Based on current logic, if the "Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date" is null, the commission fee and tax calculation is done correctly.
 This field gets populated once the "Liability Insurance Policy #" is filled in the order.
To replicate the issue, we created the liability order Q050023214 on UAT8 and followed the steps below:
 1. Create an Liability Insuracne Opportunity.
 2. Create an Liability Insuracne Quote.
 3. Create an Liability Order.
 4. Check the clerical error flag In Order.
 5. Now change the Status of Order to "Liability Clerical Error".
 6. Now uncheck the clerical error flag In Order.
 7. Now the button of "Create Spreadsheet" is enable.
 8. Now Create the Liability Spreadsheet through "Create Spreadsheet" button.
Now We get the commission fee details same Chugoku Production Order.
Fix Plan: We recommend adding one more condition to enable the "Create Spreadsheet" button — the "Vehicle Liability Insurance Certificate Issue Date" should have a valid value before the button is enabled.
Kindly validate the RCA and approve the fix plan. 
Please let us know if any recovery is required. 
Best Regards,
 Shivam

comments.text:
Dear Shiromoto San,
Thank you for your support.
*RCA*: 
In the Power BI report, the field X_REPAIR_COST has a null value in both the Warehouse DB and Siebel DB for AR# H000109757.
Since X_REPAIR_COST is aggregated using SUM, Power BI automatically ignores null values instead of treating them as zero. As a result, AR# H000109757 does not contribute to the total sum and does not appear in visuals that display only aggregated results.
Additionally, there are multiple ARs where X_REPAIR_COST is null.
*Fix*: To address this issue, we have two possible solutions:
1. Modify the logic in ODI to convert null values of X_REPAIR_COST to 0 before loading the data.
2. Modify the logic in Power BI to handle null values appropriately.
We will finalize and implement the appropriate solution, and in the meantime, we will manually recover these records after business hours today.
Regards,
Sheetal

comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda
Thank you for your continued support.
 
After reproducing this issue, we discovered that the "51: Complaint" type job card cannot be linked directly to a new car order.
 However, we observed that the user followed the steps below when creating new vehicle order number A000121450:
 # The user created a job card with the type "22: New car modification (movement)".
 # When the job card is completed, the new car order is linked to the internal order number field.
 # Changed the job card type to "51: Claim" before completing the job card.
As a result, this job card order is tied to a new car order.
 Based on the above, we have determined that this issue was caused by a user error.
Therefore, we would like to reject this matter and ask for your confirmation.
 
Thank you for your support.

comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
When user creates a Payer Change Order, values in Bill to Basic Account and Ship to basic account is fetched from JCO. Then user changes the payer in Bill to Basic Account and values in Closed Date and Payment term should be reflected according to new Payer entered. But when user enters the value in Bill to basic account, the closed date field value is not updated and old value remains in the change order. Because of this, closed date was not changed to 25 in the change order and hence not sent to KB. Since the date was EOM, all the JC lines and change order lines were sent to KB on EOM(31st March).
Fix Plan: We will fix this issue where closed date will be updated when user enters the new payer in Bill to basic account. We will share the fix on UAT1 by 24th April. 
Meanwhile, please let us know if you have any query or need any additional information.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

宮内さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
問題概要：
ユーザーが支払者変更オーダーを作成する際、「Bill to Basic Account（請求先基本アカウント）」および「Ship to Basic Account（出荷先基本アカウント）」の値はJCOから取得されます。その後、ユーザーが「Bill to Basic Account」に別の支払者を入力した場合、「Closed Date（締日）」および「Payment Term（支払条件）」は、新しく入力された支払者に基づいて更新される必要があります。
しかし現状では、ユーザーが「Bill to Basic Account」に新しい支払者を入力しても「Closed Date」の値が更新されず、変更オーダーには以前の値が残ったままになります。
その結果、本件では「Closed Date」が「25」に更新されず、変更オーダーに反映されなかったため、データがKBへ送信されませんでした。もとの締日が月末（EOM）であったため、すべてのJCラインと変更オーダーラインは3月31日にKBへ送信されました。
修正計画：
「Bill to Basic Account」に新しい支払者を入力した際に「Closed Date」が正しく更新されるよう、本事象の修正を行います。
この修正は 4月24日までにUAT1環境へリリース予定 です。
ご不明点や追加情報が必要な場合は、お気軽にご連絡ください。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Miyauchi,
Thank you for your continued support.
Problem summary:
When a user creates a payer change order, the "Bill to Basic Account" and "Ship to Basic Account" values are retrieved from the JCO. If the user subsequently enters a different payer in the Bill to Basic Account, the Closed Date and Payment Term must be updated based on the newly entered payer.
However, currently, when a user enters a new payer in the "Bill to Basic Account", the "Closed Date" value is not updated and the change order remains with the previous value.
As a result, in this case, the "Closed Date" was not updated to "25" and was not reflected in the change order, so the data was not sent to KB. All JC lines and change order lines were sent to KB on March 31st as the original closing date was the end of the month (EOM).
Modification plan:
We will correct this issue so that the "Closed Date" will be updated correctly when a new payer is entered in the "Bill to Basic Account".
This fix will be released to the UAT1 environment by April 24th.
If you have any questions or require additional information, please feel free to contact us.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.author: Ujjwal Goel
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-san,
After analyzing the issue, we have determined that RCA of this jira is same as MFTBCFFR 3641 that there is no city code in the address associated with the account used in the Sales Order.
We have replicated the issue on UAT 6 (Sales Order: A000026083). Below are the steps to replicate the issue:
Step 1: Create an Opportunity with Account code: 0000032930.
Step 2: Create and approve the quote.
Step 3: Create a Sales Order for the respective quote and approve the Sales Order.
Step 4: During the approval process for the Sales Posting of the Sales Order, when you attempt to approve the second approval from the Inbox, you will encounter a pop-up error. As a result, you will not be able to change the status to "Approved."
Step 5: Despite the inability to approve the Inbox, the Sales Order’s approval status in the approval history will show as "Approved," a Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Order will be created, and the status of your Order will change to "Sales Posting Completed."
Step 6: In the Inbox, when you reject the approval, the order status will change to "Rejected." You can then generate approvals again. If you repeat the process from Step 4, you will notice multiple Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Orders being generated.
Error Message in error logs : 次のフィールドは必須です：口座、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、郵便番号、主要郵便番号日(SBL-BPR-00131)
Proposed Fix: To address this issue, we will ensure that the pop-up error currently encountered during the inbox approval process will be triggered when clicking "Generate Approval."
Please let us know if you need further clarification or assistance.
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

After analyzing the issue, we have determined that the problem arises because there is no city code in the address associated with the account used in the Sales Order.
We have replicated the issue on UAT 6 (Sales Order: A000026083). Below are the steps to replicate the issue:
Step 1: Create an Opportunity with Account code: 0000032930.
 Step 2: Create and approve the quote.
 Step 3: Create a Sales Order for the respective quote and approve the Sales Order.
 Step 4: During the approval process for the Sales Posting of the Sales Order, when you attempt to approve the second approval from the Inbox, you will encounter a pop-up error. As a result, you will not be able to change the status to "Approved."
 Step 5: Despite the inability to approve the Inbox, the Sales Order’s approval status in the approval history will show as "Approved," a Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Order will be created, and the status of your Order will change to "Sales Posting Completed."
 Step 6: In the Inbox, when you reject the approval, the order status will change to "Rejected." You can then generate approvals again. If you repeat the process from Step 4, you will notice multiple Planned Pool Cost - Shipment Orders being generated.
Proposed Fix: To address this issue, we will ensure that the pop-up error currently encountered during the inbox approval process will be triggered when clicking "Generate Approval."
Message in error log for this case : 次のフィールドは必須です：口座、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、勘定コード、郵便番号、主要郵便番号日(SBL-BPR-00131)
Replicated Order on uat 6:
Pop-up error:
Please let us know if you need further clarification or assistance.
Best regards,
 Ujjwal Goel

Thank you for your continued support.
We have checked the RCA for the above issue, and our findings are as follows:
The JV for Liability Orders is created as soon as the Spreadsheet Status changes to "Spreadsheet Approved".
The "Spreadsheet Status" field is still editable even after the status changes to "Spreadsheet Approved". Please find the attached screenshot for reference.
For the given JC, which is linked to Sales Order#: Q050057080, two spreadsheets were created:
11SCS-17-24-00052-01
11SCS-17-24-00052-02
Spreadsheet 11SCS-17-24-00052-01 was approved and then manually "Cancelled", but since it was approved, the JV was already created.
Later, a new spreadsheet, 11SCS-17-24-00052-02, was created and approved again, which triggered the creation of another JV.
Please confirm if any recovery is required.
To avoid this issue, we suggest making the Spreadsheet Status field read-only on the UI once the status is no longer "Spreadsheet Created".
Please let us know if you have any further query.
Best regards,
Shivam

宮内さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
上記の事象についてRCAを確認し、以下の内容を特定しました。
負債オーダーのJVは、スプレッドシートステータスが「Spreadsheet Approved」に変更された時点で作成されます。
 「Spreadsheet Status」フィールドは、ステータスが「Spreadsheet Approved」になった後も引き続き編集可能です。（参考のため、スクリーンショットを添付しております。）
対象のJC（Sales Order#: Q050057080 に紐づく）では、以下の2つのスプレッドシートが作成されました。
11SCS-17-24-00052-01

Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
 The list price in Parts Internal Order is fetched from NV Sales Order. In NV Sales Order Start Price is set as null when user adds Part through sub quote in NV quote.
 We have replicated this issue on UAT1. For NV Sales Order A001293389, we added part ###600SILVER through sub quote in NV quote. When sub quote is completed , part is added in NV Quote, during this process Start price of the part is set as null which leads to null list price in Parts Internal Order (M001293390). 
We are working on the fix of this issue and will provide the fix on UAT1 by 31st March. Meanwhile, please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
この問題を詳しく分析した結果、以下のような所見が得られました。
部品社内オーダーのリスト価格は新車受注（NV Sales Order）から取得されます。新車見積（NV Quote）でサブ見積（Sub Quote）を使用して部品を追加すると、新車受注の開始価格（Start Price）がnullに設定されます。
この問題をUAT1環境で再現しました。NV Sales Order「A001293389」において、サブ見積を使用して部品「###600SILVER」を追加しました。サブ見積の完了後、部品がNV見積に追加される際に開始価格がnullに設定され、それが原因で部品社内オーダー（M001293390）のリスト価格もnullになりました。

Dear Tsunoda-san,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
After analyzing the issue, we have determined the root cause as follows:
 
Typically, when an invoice is created, the "Billing Status Code" field in the sales order items related to the invoice is updated to "Invoiced." However, in this case, this update did not occur, which is preventing the Registration Request from being completed.
 
As this problem is rare and difficult to replicate, we have considered a preventive measure.
 
The preventive measure we propose involves updating the order line items where the billing code status should have been invoiced but was not processed correctly. To address this, we will trigger a workflow when the "Create Registration Request" button is clicked. The workflow will check the sales order line items whose status should have been invoiced but is not, and will update their billing code status to "Invoiced."
 
Please let us know if you have any feedback or concerns regarding this approach.
 
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

この問題は発生頻度が低く、再現が困難であるため、防止策を検討しました。
提案する防止策として、本来「請求済み」に更新されるべき受注明細のステータスが処理されていない場合に、それを更新する仕組みを導入します。具体的には、「自動請求」ボタンをクリックした際にワークフローを起動し、「請求済み」に更新されるべき受注明細の請求ステータスコードをチェックし、未処理のものを「請求済み」に更新するようにします。

Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
After analyzing this issue, we identified the root cause as follows:
Typically, when an invoice is created, the Billing Status Code field on its associated order line is updated to "Invoiced." However, in this case, this update was not made and an additional invoice was created.
Because this issue occurs infrequently and is difficult to reproduce, we looked into ways to prevent it.
As a proposed preventive measure, we will introduce a mechanism to update the status of an order item that should have been updated to "Invoiced" if it has not been processed. Specifically, when the "Automatic Billing" button is clicked, a workflow is started, the billing status code of the order details that should be updated to "Invoiced" is checked, and the unprocessed ones are updated to "Invoiced".
If you have any comments or concerns regarding this policy, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.author: Ujjwal Goel
comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
After analyzing the issue, we have determined the root cause as follows:
Typically, when an invoice is created, the "Billing Status Code" field in the sales order items related to the invoice is updated to "Invoiced." However, in this case, this update did not occur, resulting in the creation of an additional invoice.
As this problem is rare and difficult to replicate, we have considered a preventive measure.
The preventive measure we propose involves updating the order line items where the billing code status should have been invoiced but was not processed correctly. To address this, we will trigger a workflow when the "Auto Invoice" button is clicked. The workflow will check the sales order line items whose status should have been invoiced but is not, and will update their billing code status to "Invoiced."
Please let us know if you have any feedback or concerns regarding this approach.
Best regards,
Ujjwal Goel

Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
After analyzing this issue, we identified the root cause as follows:
Typically, when an invoice is created, the Billing Status Code field on its associated order line is updated to "Invoiced." However, in this case, this update was not made and an additional invoice was created.
Because this issue occurs infrequently and is difficult to reproduce, we looked into ways to prevent it.
As a proposed preventive measure, we will introduce a mechanism to update the status of an order item that should have been updated to "Invoiced" if it has not been processed. Specifically, when the "Automatic Billing" button is clicked, a workflow is started, the billing status code of the order details that should be updated to "Invoiced" is checked, and the unprocessed ones are updated to "Invoiced".
If you have any comments or concerns regarding this policy, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

いつもお世話になっております。
本件について詳しく調査を行い、以下のとおり結果をご報告いたします。
Journal Voucher において、ジャーナルイベント「ConsTax PO - Body Building Order - IBOS」および「PO - Body Building Order - IBOS」が設定されている場合、購入オーダー の Actual shipment date が Posting date として設定される仕様となっております。

何卒よろしくお願いいたします
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
We will conduct a detailed investigation into this matter and report the results as follows.
In Journal Voucher, when the journal events "ConsTax PO - Body Building Order - IBOS" and "PO - Body Building Order - IBOS" are set, the Actual shipment date of the purchase order is set as the Posting date.
In the Body Building Order you provided this time, the actual shipment date is November 21, 2024, so the same date is also reflected in the Journal Voucher's Posting date.
This behavior is an existing specification of the system and is not a defect. Therefore, we would like to dismiss this incident.
If you have any questions or need additional information, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.text:
*RCA:* The issue occurs due to data migration and editable Sales Order # field in UV Inventory screen.
In FDP a new flag “Previous Assessment Flag” was created which is set to Y for all the UV Pool Cost-Procurement, Job Card Order and UV Body Building Orders if the parent UV Sales Order is Sales Posting Completed. This flag ensures that purchase orders associated with old UV Sales Order are not visible on UI if the vehicle is stocked in again.
During data migration, this flag was not set to “Y” so user was able to see all the previous purchase orders on UI and was able to change the Sales Order #.
*Preventive Measures:* We will perform recovery for all the migrated order tonight so that they are not visible under UV Inventory screen after restock in.
Also, we suggest to make this field read only on UI because user can change the Sales Order # for any purchase order that is associated with stocked in vehicle and KB Map/Unmap trigger is not created in this user operation.
Please let us know if you have any further query.
Best Regards,
Shivam

城本さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
*RCA:*
 この問題は、データ移行およびUV在庫画面のSales Order #フィールドが編集可能であることに起因しています。
 FDPでは、新たに「Previous Assessment Flag」というフラグを作成し、親UV Sales OrderがSales Posting Completedの場合、以下のオーダーすべてに対してこのフラグをYに設定する仕様となっています。
 UV Pool Cost-Procurement
 Job Card Order
 UV Body Building Orders
 このフラグを設定することで、過去のUV Sales Orderに紐づく購入オーダーが、車両が再入庫された場合にUI上に表示されないようにする仕組みになっています。
 しかし、データ移行時にこのフラグが「Y」に設定されていなかったため、ユーザーは過去の購入オーダーをUI上で確認・Sales Order #を変更できる状態になっていました。
*予防策:*
 本日夜、移行されたすべてのオーダーに対してリカバリーを実施し、再入庫後にUV在庫画面に表示されないよう対応いたします。
 また、ユーザーが在庫された車両に紐づく購入オーダーのSales Order #を変更できる仕様となっており、
 この操作ではKB Map/Unmapのトリガーが作成されないため、UI上でこのフィールドを読み取り専用にすることを推奨いたします。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
 ハーシュ
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Shiromoto,
Thank you for your continued support.
*RCA:*
 This issue is due to the Sales Order # field on the Data Migration and UV Inventory screens being editable.
 In FDP, a new flag called "Previous Assessment Flag" is created, and if the parent UV Sales Order is Sales Posting Completed, this flag is set to Y for all orders below.
 UV Pool Cost-Procurement
 Job Card Order
 UV Body Building Orders
 By setting this flag, purchase orders associated with past UV Sales Orders will not be displayed on the UI when the vehicle is re-stocked.
 However, because this flag was not set to "Y" during data migration, users were able to view past purchase orders and change the Sales Order # on the UI.
*Precautions:*
 This evening, we will perform recovery for all migrated orders and ensure that they do not appear on the UV inventory screen after being restocked.
 Additionally, users can change the Sales Order # of purchase orders associated with vehicles in stock.
 This operation does not create a KB Map/Unmap trigger, so we recommend making this field read-only on the UI.
Thank you very much for your support.
 Hirsch

comments.text:
Thanks for your continued support.
 We have investigated above issue and below are our findings.
 1. User is able to do the Sales Posting even if the JCO is not created(Service Quote is not "Customer Approved"). As per the current functionality in FDP, there is no check while doing sales positng if there is no JCO. 
 2. As soon as Service Quote status changes to "Customer Approved" JCO is created and now without closing the respective Job Card user will not be able to do the Sales Posting.
In above Sales Order, it seems there is a user mis operation. The user may not have progressed the Service Quote to "Customer Approved", which prevented the creation of JCO. As per FDP's functionality, Sales Posting is still allowed.
In SC version, there is a validation for the first point — when changing the status of a Delivery Request to "Completed", a validation message is displayed.
 Please let us know if we need to implement a similar validation in FDP as well.
Best Regards,
 Shivam

いつもお世話になっております。
本件について調査を行い、以下の点を確認いたしました。
1. JCO が作成されていない場合（Service Quote が「Customer Approved」になっていない場合）でも、ユーザーは Sales Posting を行うことが可能です。現行の FDP の仕様では、JCO の有無を Sales Posting の際にチェックする仕組みはありません。 
2. 一方、Service Quote のステータスが「Customer Approved」に変更されると JCO が作成され、それ以降は該当する Job Card をクローズしない限り Sales Posting は行えません。
今回の Sales Order については、ユーザー操作の誤りである可能性があります。ユーザーが Service Quote を「Customer Approved」に進めなかったため、JCO が作成されず、その状態でも FDP の仕様上 Sales Posting が許可されたと考えられます。
なお、SC バージョンでは 1 点目のケースに対して、Delivery Request のステータスを「Completed」に変更する際に、検証メッセージが表示される仕様となっています。
FDP においても同様のバリデーションを実装する必要があるか、ご確認のほどお願いいたします。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
thank you always.
We investigated this matter and confirmed the following points.
1. Even if a JCO is not created (Service Quote is not "Customer Approved"), users can still perform Sales Posting. In the current FDP specifications, there is no mechanism to check the presence of JCO during Sales Posting. 
2. On the other hand, when the Service Quote status is changed to "Customer Approved", a JCO is created and Sales Posting cannot be performed after that unless the corresponding Job Card is closed.
This Sales Order may be due to a user operation error. Because the user did not advance the Service Quote to "Customer Approved," the JCO was not created, and Sales Posting was still allowed under the FDP specifications.
In addition, in the SC version, a verification message is displayed when changing the status of the Delivery Request to "Completed" for the first case.
Please check whether you need to implement similar validation in FDP as well.
Thank you very much for your support.

Dear Tsunoda San, 
Thanks for your support. 
Please find below the analysis details for incident *MFTBCFFR: 3546* regarding the issue where the recycle order was not displayed in the Chugoku Production environment.
*Root Cause Analysis (RCA):*
The *D21F* file was received and processed before the *D21A* file. Since the chassis record had not yet been created during the D21A file execution, the recycle fee order could not be created during the D21F execution.
*Recovery Action:*
As part of the recovery, the *D21F* process was re-executed after the successful completion of the *D21A* process. This resulted in the successful creation of the recycle fee order.
*Countermeasure:*
As this issue was caused by the sequence of *TOB* file processing and is *not related to the Siebel system*, we are unable to provide a Siebel-side countermeasure for this scenario.
*Monitoring:*
To avoid such errors, Cubastion has configured email notifications to alert the team whenever any file execution fails. This enables us to promptly identify unprocessed or failed files and take timely recovery actions whenever required.
Since this issue was caused by the TOB file processing sequence and is not related to the Siebel system, we would like to proceed with closing this Jira ticket.
Best Regards,
Deepika Raheja

Dear Tsunoda San,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
We would like to report the results of our investigation regarding **incident MFTBCFFR-3546 (recycling fee order not displayed on chassis order in production environment in China)**.
 
■ Cause (RCA)
 
After investigation, we confirmed that the D21F file was received and processed before the D21A file.
 
At the time of D21F processing, a recycling fee order could not be created because the chassis order (vehicle information) by D21A had not yet been created.
 
■ Recovery support
 
We have confirmed that re-running the D21F process after completing the D21A process will successfully create a recycling fee order.
 
■ Measures to prevent recurrence
 
This event is caused by the TOB file processing order and is not a problem with the Siebel system, so there is no system modification that can be done on the Siebel side.
 
Additionally, in order to detect similar events at an early stage, Cubastion has introduced a monitoring function that sends email notifications when file processing fails.
 
This allows us to quickly detect processing failures and unprocessed files, and promptly implement recovery measures if necessary.
 
We have confirmed that this issue is caused by the TOB file processing order and is not a problem with the Siebel system, so we would like to close this JIRA.
 
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
 
Thank you for your support.

本件では、対応するD21Aファイルより先にD21Fファイルが受信・処理されました。D21F処理時点ではシャーシオーダーがまだ作成されていなかったため、リサイクル料オーダーの作成条件を満たさず、リサイクル料オーダーを作成することができませんでした。
また、2025年の最初のコメントでD21Eと記載してしまいましたが、正しくはD21AとD21Fです。誤った記載となってしまい、申し訳ございませんでした。
 
RCAでご説明している内容は一貫しており、本件の原因はD21FファイルがD21Aファイルより先に処理されたことです。そのため、前提となるシャシオーダーが存在せず、リサイクル料オーダーを作成することができませんでした。
 
ご不明な点やご質問がございましたら、お気軽にお知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。

The *D21A* file is responsible for creating the *chassis order*, while the *D21F* file is responsible for creating the *recycle fee order*. In this case, the *D21F file was received and processed before the corresponding D21A file*. Since the chassis order had not yet been created by the D21A processing, the prerequisite for creating the recycle fee order was not met. As a result, the recycle fee order could not be created during the D21F processing.
We apologize for the error in the very first comment(in 2025) where *D21E* was mentioned. The correct files are *D21A* and *D21F*, and the RCA has always referred to the processing sequence between these two files. The issue occurred because the *D21F file (recycle fee order creation)* was processed before the *D21A file (chassis order creation)*, preventing the recycle fee order from being created as the prerequisite chassis order did not yet exist.

Dear @Shiromoto, Hideaki (575) San,
Thank you very much for your continued support.
RCA: The events in this case are as follows.
A user creates an order from a quote that includes two parts items.
A user created a "Parts Internal Order" and then a "Return order" for both parts items.
The user has revised the quote.
I deleted the old item (2 parts) and added the new part item (2 parts).
Through this sequence, new part items were also assigned the same line number. As a result, when users synced quotes and orders, they were synced with existing part items and no new items were created. Additionally, the parts order was already created for the old item, which caused the operation to stop.
As this is a very rare occurrence, we ask that you please monitor your systems for similar occurrences in the future and check with our business team to find a better and more efficient solution to control this issue.

Thank you for your support.
For this issue the probable fixes are as follows:
*Issue:* In D21Z file the date which is received from the TOB side does is in the format of *MMDD*  and not having the Year.
*Fix Plan-1*: Considering the Shipment date will be older than the  D21Z file execution data. We will compare the Shipment date received in the file to the file execution date and if the Shipment date is greater than the file execution date in the format of *MMDD* then we will take the previous year. Otherwise the current year. 
This change needs to be handled at the ODI side. So a project CR will be required for this.
*Fix Plan 2:* As the Shipment date is already updated by the D21N file. So, the Shipment date updating process from D21Z file will be stopped. This can be done by AMS-CR
*Fix Plan 3*: If TOB can send the year in the D21Z file then we can update the same in the Siebel system.
These are the probable fix plans to handle these types of issues.
In case a detailed discussion is required, we can also schedule a call for the same.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra

角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
本件の問題について、以下のような対応案を考えております。
■ 問題点
D21Zファイルにおいて、TOB側から受領する日付がMMDD形式となっており、Year（年）の情報が含まれていません。
■ 対応案 
① 修正案1
Shipment DateはD21Zファイルの実行日より過去の日付であることを前提とし、以下のルールで処理を行います。 
Shipment Date（MMDD形式）がファイル実行日より大きい場合：前年を適用
それ以外の場合：当年を適用
この変更はODI側での対応が必要となるため、プロジェクトCRの申請が必要です。
② 修正案2
Shipment DateはすでにD21Nファイルにより更新されているため、D21ZファイルからのShipment Date更新処理を停止する対応です。
この場合、AMS-CRにて対応可能です。
③ 修正案3
TOB側でD21ZファイルにYear(年)の情報を含めていただける場合、それをSiebelシステムに反映する形で対応可能です。
以上が今回の問題に対する対応案となります。
ご不明点や詳細なご相談が必要な場合は、別途お打ち合わせを設定することも可能ですので、必要でしたら、ご連絡ください。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
Regarding this issue, we are considering the following solutions.
■ Problems
In the D21Z file, the date received from the TOB side is in MMDD format and does not include Year information.
■ Countermeasure plan
① Amendment 1
It is assumed that the Shipment Date is a date in the past than the execution date of the D21Z file, and processing is performed according to the following rules. 
If the Shipment Date (MMDD format) is greater than the file execution date: apply the previous year
Otherwise: apply current year
Since this change requires action on the ODI side, a project CR application is required.
② Amendment 2
Since the Shipment Date has already been updated by the D21N file, this will stop the Shipment Date update process from the D21Z file.
In this case, AMS-CR can be used.
③ Amendment 3
If the TOB side can include Year information in the D21Z file, we can reflect it in the Siebel system.
The above is a solution to this problem.
If you have any questions or need detailed consultation, we can set up a separate meeting, so please contact us if necessary.

Thanks for your continued support.
This is due to inconsistent data in SC Prod.
In Vehicle there are 3 columns, X_KEY, SERIAL_NUM, ASSET_NUM. Ideally these three column should have same value. But In the above case, ASSET_NUM "FK62F-605267", the value in X_KEY and SERIAL_NUM is "FU74HZ-510966". 
In data migration we have used ASSET_NUM as the user key, and the value in X_KEY and SERIAL_NUM is same as ASSET_NUM in Chugoku Production. 
Please let us know if you have any further query.
Best Regards,
Shivam

comments.author: Sheetal
comments.text:
Dear Shiromoto-San,
Thank you for your support.
*RCA:*
Currently, our logic retrieves Profit (Sales Price - Cost Price) based on the formula: *Cost Price = Cost * Quantity*, regardless of the DELETE_FLG status in the Datamart database.
However, line items deleted from the Siebel side still exist in the Datamart DB, marked with *DELETE_FLG = 'Y'*, while active line items in Siebel are marked as *DELETE_FLG = 'N'* in Datamart.
Since the PBI report doesn't have a filter to separate deleted line items, causing the difference in Profit values between the PBI report and Siebel. 
*Fix Plan:* 
We are actively working on resolving this issue and expect to implement the fix by *14/03/2025* on UAT.In the meantime, we will proceed with the recovery of impacted records.
Regards,
Sheetal

城本さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
以下は、Sheetalさんのメールの翻訳になります。
RCA:
現在のロジックでは、DELETE_FLG のステータスに関係なく、以下の計算式で利益 (販売価格 - 原価) を取得しています。
原価 = 原価 × 数量
しかし、Siebel 側で削除された明細は Datamart DB に DELETE_FLG = 'Y' として残り、一方で Siebel 上で有効な明細は Datamart 上で DELETE_FLG = 'N' として管理されています。
PBI レポートには削除された明細を除外するフィルターがないため、PBI レポートと Siebel の間で利益の値に差異が生じていました。
修正計画:

RCA:
The current logic is to obtain profit (sales price - cost) using the following formula, regardless of the status of DELETE_FLG.
Cost = Cost × Quantity
However, the lines deleted on the Siebel side remain in the Datamart DB with DELETE_FLG = 'Y', while the lines that are valid on Siebel are managed on the Datamart as DELETE_FLG = 'N'.
PBI reports did not have a filter to exclude deleted lines, resulting in discrepancies in profit values ​​between PBI reports and Siebel.

本件について詳細に分析した結果、根本原因を特定しました。架装発注に負のコストおよびリスト価格が設定されている場合、販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存され、それが問題を引き起こしていることが判明しました。
以下の手順で問題を再現しました。
**再現手順:**
1. 見積に架装発注アイテムを追加し、リスト価格とコストの両方を負の値で入力する。
2. 見積を承認し、その見積を基にオーダーを作成する。
3. オーダーを承認し、「Create Purchase Order」ボタンをクリックして架装発注の発注書を作成する。
4. 架装発注の発注書を承認し、その後、見積を修正する。修正後、架装発注オーダーに見積アイテムが同期される。
**根本原因分析 (RCA):**
「Create Purchase Order」ボタンを使用して架装発注の発注書を作成すると、ワークフローがトリガーされます。しかし、負の価格のバリデーションによってこのワークフローが中断されます。その結果、架装発注オーダーに販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存されます。
その後、見積を修正すると、同じQuote IDを持つすべての販売オーダーを検索し、行アイテムを同期します。このため、Quote IDを持つ架装発注オーダーの行アイテムも、販売オーダーと一緒に同期されてしまいます。
**UATでの再現:**
 - **架装発注オーダー:** B001292881 (UAT 1)
 - **販売オーダー:** A001292880 (UAT 1)
本件のUAT環境での修正予定日は **3月7日** です。
ご不明点や追加のサポートが必要な場合は、お知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
After a detailed analysis of this issue, we have identified the root cause. It turns out that when a bodywork order has a negative cost and list price, the sales order's Quote ID is saved, which is causing the issue.
I reproduced the problem using the steps below.
**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Add a bodywork order item to the quote and enter both the list price and cost as negative values.
2. Approve the quote and create an order based on the quote.
3. Approve the order and click the "Create Purchase Order" button to create a purchase order for the bodywork order.
4. Approve the purchase order for the bodywork order and then revise the estimate. After modification, the quoted item is synchronized to the bodywork purchase order.
**Root Cause Analysis (RCA):**
Creating a purchase order for a bodywork order using the Create Purchase Order button triggers a workflow. However, negative price validation breaks this workflow. As a result, the sales order's Quote ID is saved in the bodywork purchase order.
Later, when you amend the quote, it will find all sales orders with the same Quote ID and sync the line items. As a result, bodywork purchase order line items with Quote IDs will also be synchronized with the sales order.
**Reproduction on UAT:**
 - **Bodywork order:** B001292881 (UAT 1)
 - **Sales Order:** A001292880 (UAT 1)
The expected fix date for this issue in the UAT environment is **March 7**.
If you have any questions or need additional support, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

The analysis for the issue is completed. 
RCA: In this case it seems that there is some user operation steps involved:
Step 1- User created the UV Sales Order from UV Sales Quote.
Step 2- User changed the product type from Additional Body line item to Liability insurance Line item. 
Step 3- Now to revert user mistakenly changed the Product type from the Liability line item to Additional Body.
Step 4 - User created the Expense invoice for the Sales Order with the interchanged line items.
Step 5- User revised the UV Sales Quote and synced it with UV Sales Order.
So during this sync the interchange of Additional Body line item with Liability Insurance line item was restored to original positions.
But as invoice was created from the interchanged one's therefore during Tax Finalization in Registration request user got the error to create the expense for the items.
We have replicated the issue on UAT-01, reference order: E001292965.
So, this is a case of User Mis-operation. 
 
Recovery: Recovery is already completed for the affected record.

角田さん、
いつもお世話になっております。 
 
本件について詳細に分析した結果、根本原因を特定しました。架装発注に負のコストおよびリスト価格が設定されている場合、販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存され、それが問題を引き起こしていることが判明しました。 
 
以下の手順で問題を再現しました。 
 
**再現手順:** 
1. 見積に架装発注アイテムを追加し、リスト価格とコストの両方を負の値で入力する。 
2. 見積を承認し、その見積を基にオーダーを作成する。 
3. オーダーを承認し、「Create Purchase Order」ボタンをクリックして架装発注の発注書を作成する。 
4. 架装発注の発注書を承認し、その後、見積を修正する。修正後、架装発注オーダーに見積アイテムが同期される。 
 
**根本原因分析 (RCA):** 
「Create Purchase Order」ボタンを使用して架装発注の発注書を作成すると、ワークフローがトリガーされます。しかし、負の価格のバリデーションによってこのワークフローが中断されます。その結果、架装発注オーダーに販売オーダーのQuote IDが保存されます。 
その後、見積を修正すると、同じQuote IDを持つすべての販売オーダーを検索し、行アイテムを同期します。このため、Quote IDを持つ架装発注オーダーの行アイテムも、販売オーダーと一緒に同期されてしまいます。 
 
**UATでの再現:** 
- **架装発注オーダー:** B001292881 (UAT 1) 
- **販売オーダー:** A001292880 (UAT 1) 
 
本件のUAT環境での修正予定日は **3月7日** です。 
 
ご不明点や追加のサポートが必要な場合は、お知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support. 
 
After a detailed analysis of this issue, we have identified the root cause. It turns out that when a bodywork order has a negative cost and list price, the sales order's Quote ID is saved, which is causing the issue. 
 
I reproduced the problem using the steps below. 
 
**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Add a bodywork order item to the quote and enter both the list price and cost as negative values. 
2. Approve the quote and create an order based on the quote. 
3. Approve the order and click the "Create Purchase Order" button to create a purchase order for the bodywork order. 
4. Approve the purchase order for the bodywork order and then revise the estimate. After modification, the quoted item is synchronized to the bodywork purchase order. 
 
**Root Cause Analysis (RCA):**
Creating a purchase order for a bodywork order using the Create Purchase Order button triggers a workflow. However, negative price validation breaks this workflow. As a result, the sales order's Quote ID is saved in the bodywork purchase order. 
Later, when you amend the quote, it will find all sales orders with the same Quote ID and sync the line items. As a result, bodywork purchase order line items with Quote IDs will also be synchronized with the sales order. 
 
**Reproduction on UAT:**
- **Bodywork order:** B001292881 (UAT 1)
- **Sales Order:** A001292880 (UAT 1)
 
The expected fix date for this issue in the UAT environment is **March 7**. 
 
If you have any questions or need additional support, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.

comments.text:
角田さん、
お世話になっております。
返事が遅くなり申し訳ありません。
**■ 問題の概要** 
本件はデータ移行に起因して発生しました。
**■ 根本原因** 
請求書ステータスが **「完了」** の場合、本来であれば請求書の **行番号**（中国環境）が **「税金」** タイプの注文明細に紐づくはずでした。 
しかし、移行時に請求書は **「完了」** ステータスで登録されていたものの、**SC環境の古い行番号** が **「税金」** タイプの注文明細に紐づいたままとなっていました。
**■ 対応策** 
該当レコードを修正し、中国環境の **新しい行番号** に紐づける対応を実施しました。
**■ 再発防止策** 
本件はデータ移行時の設定ミスによるものであり、今後同様の問題が発生しないよう注意を払います。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
ハーシュ
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your help.
Sorry for the late reply.
**■ Problem summary**
This issue occurred due to data migration.
**■ Root cause**
When the invoice status is **Completed**, the invoice **line number** (in China environment) should have been associated with the **``Tax"** type of PO line. 
However, at the time of migration, the invoices were registered with a status of ``Completed'', but the **old line number in the SC environment** was still associated with the **``Tax''** type of PO line.
**■ Countermeasures**
We have corrected the record and linked it to the **new line number** in the Chinese environment.
**■ Recurrence prevention measures**
This issue is due to a configuration error during data migration, and we will take precautions to prevent similar issues from occurring in the future.
Thank you very much for your support.
Hirsch

Thank you for your continued support.
We have investigated further, and here are the additional details:
When the daily settlement process is performed through SonpoWeb, two interfaces are triggered:
IFIN010 (Daily Settlement) – From Siebel to SonpoWeb
IFIN011 (Settlement Confirmation) – From SonpoWeb to Siebel
In IFIN011, Siebel receives encoded data, which is then decoded within Siebel. An example of the encoded data is attached for your reference.
From this decoded data, Siebel extracts values for the following fields:
 * Policy Number
 * PPR Receive Date
 * PPR Confirm Date
 * PPR Gross Premium
 * PPR Collection Fee
 * Agent Commission Fee
 * PPR Net Premium
 * Insurance Company Code
 * Sales Rep
Siebel then checks whether the received *Policy Number* exists. If it does, a record is created in Siebel with the extracted values.
Please let us know if you have any further query.
Best regards,
Shivam

When daily payment processing is performed through SonpoWeb, the following two interfaces are triggered: 
- *IFIN010 (Daily Settlement)*: Send from Siebel to SonpoWeb
- *IFIN011 (Settlement Confirmation)*: Sent from SonpoWeb to Siebel
With IFIN011, Siebel receives encoded data and decodes it within Siebel. Please refer to the attached example of encoded data. After decoding, Siebel extracts the following items: 
- Policy number
- PPR receipt date
- PPR confirmation date
- PPR total premium
- PPR collection fee
- Agency fee
- PPR net premium
- Insurance company code
- Salesperson
Siebel then checks to see if the received policy number already exists, and if so, creates a record in Siebel with the above values.

Thank you for your ongoing support.
Please check the RCA for this issue below and Let us know if you have any query.
1.First user created External WO :- 1-E6M77 on 2025/01/29 03:54:31 PM and respective SPO :- J000188523
For this WO Work Start Date/Time is 2025/01/30 06:46:06 PM and Work completion date/time :- 2025/01/30 06:46:08 PM
 
Please note that in SPO Work Start Date/Time and Work completion date/time populated from JC Header.
For JC Header Work Start Date/Time is the Start time of WO in which work is started first (in this case 1-E6M77) and Work completion date/time is Completion time of the Last WO (in this case 1-E4SST, Work completion date/time :- 2025/01/30 06:46:45 PM).
As SPO status set to Completion of Acceptance Inspection JV is created and Posting date in JV has the value of Work completion date/time field of the SPO. 
posting date set to 30/01/2025 for JV of SPO J000188523.
 
2. Now, User created another External WO :- 1-F9HQT on 2025/02/19 01:57:28 PM and respective SPO :- J000192078 in Re-edit mode.
For this WO Work Start Date/Time is 2025/02/19 02:05:03 PM and Work completion date/time :- 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM.
 
For JC Header Work Start Date/Time is the Start time of first WO (same as before 1-E6M77) and Work completion date/time is Completion time of the Last WO (in this case 1-F9HQT, Work completion date/time :- 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM).
As SPO status set to Completion of Acceptance Inspection JV is created and Posting date in JV has the value of Work completion date/time field of the SPO. 
posting date still set to 30/01/2025 for JV of SPO J000192078 because Work completion date/time of last WO 1-F9HQT is not set to the JC Header.
 
Work completion date/time in JC Header is updated when user click the Generate Approval button on MF Job Card Detail Applet.
Once user clicked Generate Approval Work completion date/time set to 2025/02/19 02:05:04 PM in JC Header and same date is updated in both the SPO.
Posting Date in JV is correct but in SPO Screen Work Start Date/Time and Work completion date/time coming from from JC Header due to this there is a mismatch in JV and SPO dates.
We have replicated this issue on FDP UAT-1.
Ref. JC :- I001292520
Regards,
Akash

いつもお世話になっております。
以下、本件のRCAについてご確認ください。ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。
RCA
1. *最初の外部WO作成*
 - ユーザーが *2025/01/29 15:54:31* に *外部WO (1-E6M77)* を作成し、対応する *SPO (J000188523)* が生成されました。
 - 本WOの作業開始日時は *2025/01/30 18:46:06、作業完了日時は **2025/01/30 18:46:08* です。
 - SPOの作業開始日時および作業完了日時は *JCヘッダー* から取得されます。
 - JCヘッダーの作業開始日時は、最初に作業が開始されたWO（今回のケースでは *1-E6M77*）の開始時間です。
 - JCヘッダーの作業完了日時は、最後に完了したWO（今回のケースでは *1-E4SST）の完了時間（2025/01/30 18:46:45*）です。
 - *SPOのステータスが「Completion of Acceptance Inspection」に設定されたタイミングでJVが作成され、JVのPosting DateはSPOの作業完了日時が設定されます。*
 - したがって、SPO *J000188523* のJVのPosting Dateは *2025/01/30* となりました。
2. *新たな外部WO作成（Re-editモード）*
 - ユーザーが *2025/02/19 13:57:28* に *外部WO (1-F9HQT)* を作成し、対応する *SPO (J000192078)* を *Re-editモード* で生成しました。
 - 本WOの作業開始日時は *2025/02/19 14:05:03、作業完了日時は **2025/02/19 14:05:04* です。
 - *JCヘッダーの作業開始日時は、引き続き最初のWO（1-E6M77）の開始時間となります。*
 - *JCヘッダーの作業完了日時は、最後に完了したWO（今回のケースでは 1-F9HQT）の完了時間（2025/02/19 14:05:04）となります。*
 - *SPOのステータスが「Completion of Acceptance Inspection」に設定された際にJVが作成され、Posting DateにはSPOの作業完了日時が設定されるべきですが、今回はSPO J000192078のJVのPosting Dateが2025/01/30のままになりました。*
 - これは、*1-F9HQTの作業完了日時がJCヘッダーに正しく設定されていなかったため* です。
3. *承認ボタンの影響*
 - ユーザーが *MF Job Card Detail Appletで「Generate Approval」ボタンをクリックしたタイミング* で、JCヘッダーの作業完了日時が更新されました。
 - その結果、*2025/02/19 14:05:04* がJCヘッダーに設定され、両方のSPOに反映されました。
 - ただし、*SPO画面では作業開始日時・作業完了日時がJCヘッダーから取得されるため、JVとSPOの日時に不整合が発生しました。*
—

 *参照JC:* I001292520
ご確認のほどよろしくお願いいたします。

RCA
1. *First external WO creation*
 - User created *External WO (1-E6M77)* on *2025/01/29 15:54:31* and the corresponding *SPO (J000188523)* was generated.
 - The work start date and time of this WO is *2025/01/30 18:46:06, and the work completion date and time is **2025/01/30 18:46:08*.
 - SPO work start date and time and work completion date and time are obtained from *JC header*.
 - The work start date and time in the JC header is the start time of the WO (*1-E6M77* in this case) where work was first started.
 - The work completion date and time of the JC header is the completion time (2025/01/30 18:46:45*) of the last completed WO (*1-E4SST in this case).
 - *The JV will be created when the SPO status is set to "Completion of Acceptance Inspection", and the JV Posting Date will be set to the SPO work completion date and time. *
 - Therefore, the JV Posting Date for SPO *J000188523* is *2025/01/30*.
2. *Create new external WO (Re-edit mode)*
 - User created *External WO (1-F9HQT)* on *2025/02/19 13:57:28* and generated the corresponding *SPO (J000192078)* in *Re-edit mode*.
 - The work start date and time of this WO is *2025/02/19 14:05:03, and the work completion date and time is **2025/02/19 14:05:04*.
 - *The work start date and time in the JC header will continue to be the start time of the first WO (1-E6M77). *
 - *The work completion date and time of the JC header is the completion time (2025/02/19 14:05:04) of the last completed WO (1-F9HQT in this case). *
 - *JV is created when the SPO status is set to "Completion of Acceptance Inspection", and the Posting Date should be set to the SPO work completion date and time, but this time, the JV Posting Date of SPO J000192078 remained as 2025/01/30. *
 - This is because *1-F9HQT's work completion date and time was not set correctly in the JC header*.

To fix this issue we will increase the JMS connection Pool Side (increased from 60-90) to accommodate the requests for all the FDPs altogether .
Please approve the following change so that fix will be applied on the production.
Note: Only JMS level changes are required. No Siebel level changes are required.
Regards
Ashutosh Dogra

Countermeasures:
To resolve this issue, we will increase the JMS connection pool size from 60 to 90 and adjust it to handle all FDP requests.

comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
RCA: 
The issue occurred due to MFTBCFFR-3269, where we changed the IKM in ODI to *IKM Incremental Update* from *IKM Insert Global.*
As a result of this change, the IKM initially ran as a full load instead of an incremental load, leading to the deletion of records from the DataMart table. 
During the recovery process for MFTBCFFR-3269, we had a backup of the DataMart table with the old records.
We have since performed the necessary recovery to resolve this and the data is now available in the report. 
Please find the screenshot attached below.
Please let us know if this explanation is clear. If any clarification is needed, we would be happy to connect for a discussion.
Regards,
 Sheetal

Madhav

城本さん、
いつもお世話になっております。
根本原因: この場合は、評価リクエストはユーザー「D8TSAWAM」によって作成されます。このユーザーは「支店 NV/UV 営業スタッフ」です。
また、承認フロー マトリックスによると、支店営業マネージャーと支店長であり、この特定のケースの承認フロー マトリックスには含まれていないため、承認は正しい順序で行われます。
支店営業マネージャーと支店長の予想される承認は、支店営業スタッフまたは支店営業マネージャーによって作成されたレコードに対してのみ生成され、支店 NV/UV 営業スタッフに対しては生成されません。
さらに質問がある場合はお知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願い致します。

comments.text:
We have analyzed this issue and we found that while performing recovery of Jira MFTBCFFR-3159, we had checked that duplicate recycle fee orders were existing for the attached vehicles.
 * When performing recovery for duplicate recycle fee orders, we check which recycle fee order is mapped to the chassis order and is visible on UI under the chassis order screen. 
 * Furthermore, we check if the TOB status and message is present in the recycle fee order and if so, we consider the one with TOB status and message as the final one and unmap the one that has null value for TOB status and message.
 * All the duplicate recycle fee orders were in 'Pending' status and their TOB status and message was null.
 * Only difference in the duplicate recycle fee orders was their 'Created' date.
 * So we unmapped the recycle fee orders with older 'Created' date and kept the latest 'Created' recycle fee orders that were mapped to the chassis order. 
 * While doing so, we missed the fact that the older 'Created' recycle fee order could be mapped to a sales order.
 * As a result, we updated the status of the latest 'Created' recycle fee order which was visible on UI and was visible under the chassis order screen and unmapped the older 'Created' recycle fee order from the vehicle, due to which it was also unmapped from the Sales order causing this issue.
As a precautionary measure to avoid such occurrence in the future, we will add one more step in our SOP while checking for duplicate recycle fee orders to check if they are mapped to any Sales order.
Kindly let us know if you have any further queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

本件について調査を行った結果、Jira MFTBCFFR-3159 のリカバリーを実施する際に、対象車両に対して重複したリサイクル料金オーダーが存在していることを確認しました。
重複したリサイクル料金オーダーのリカバリーを行う際、どのオーダーがシャシーオーダーにマッピングされ、UI 上のシャシーオーダー画面で表示されているかを確認します。
さらに、リサイクル料金オーダーに TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが存在するかを確認し、存在する場合はそのオーダーを最終的なものとし、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが null のオーダーをアンマップします。
確認したところ、すべての重複したリサイクル料金オーダーは「Pending」ステータスであり、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージは null でした。
これらのオーダーの唯一の違いは「作成日（Created）」だったため、作成日が古いオーダーをアンマップし、最新の作成日のオーダーをシャシーオーダーにマッピングした状態で保持しました。
しかし、この作業の際に、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーが受注（Sales Order）にマッピングされている可能性を見落としていました。
その結果、UI 上で表示され、シャシーオーダー画面に表示されていた最新の作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーのステータスを更新し、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーを車両からアンマップしました。
これにより、受注からもアンマップされてしまい、本件の問題が発生しました。
今後、同様の問題を防ぐため、重複したリサイクル料金オーダーを確認する際には、それらが受注にマッピングされているかどうかを追加で確認する手順を SOP に追加いたします。
ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
As a result of investigating this issue, we have confirmed that when performing the recovery of Jira MFTBCFFR-3159, there was a duplicate recycling fee order for the target vehicle.
When recovering duplicate recycle fee orders, check which orders are mapped to chassis orders and displayed on the chassis orders screen on the UI.
Additionally, it checks if the TOB status and message exist on the recycling fee order, makes it final if it exists, and unmaps orders with null TOB status and message.
I checked and found that all duplicate recycling fee orders were in a "Pending" status with a null TOB status and message.
The only difference between these orders was the "Created" date, so we unmapped the orders with the older creation dates and kept the orders with the latest creation dates mapped to the chassis orders.
However, during this process, they overlooked the possibility that recycling fee orders with old creation dates were mapped to Sales Orders.
As a result, we updated the status of recycle fee orders with the most recent creation date displayed on the UI and displayed on the Chassis Order screen, and unmapped recycle fee orders with older creation dates from the vehicle.
As a result, it was also unmapped from the order, causing this issue.
To prevent similar issues in the future, we will add a step to our SOPs when reviewing duplicate recycling fee orders to ensure they are mapped to a sales order.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you for your support.

comments.text:
We have analyzed this issue and we found that while performing recovery of Jira MFTBCFFR-3159, we had checked that duplicate recycle fee orders were existing for the attached vehicles.
 * When performing recovery for duplicate recycle fee orders, we check which recycle fee order is mapped to the chassis order and is visible on UI under the chassis order screen. 
 * Furthermore, we check if the TOB status and message is present in the recycle fee order and if so, we consider the one with TOB status and message as the final one and unmap the one that has null value for TOB status and message.
 * All the duplicate recycle fee orders were in 'Pending' status and their TOB status and message was null.
 * Only difference in the duplicate recycle fee orders was their 'Created' date.
 * So we unmapped the recycle fee orders with older 'Created' date and kept the latest 'Created' recycle fee orders that were mapped to the chassis order. 
 * While doing so, we missed the fact that the older 'Created' recycle fee order could be mapped to a sales order.
 * As a result, we updated the status of the latest 'Created' recycle fee order which was visible on UI and was visible under the chassis order screen and unmapped the older 'Created' recycle fee order from the vehicle, due to which it was also unmapped from the Sales order causing this issue.
As a precautionary measure to avoid such occurrence in the future, we will add one more step in our SOP while checking for duplicate recycle fee orders to check if they are mapped to any Sales order.
Kindly let us know if you have any further queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

角田さん、

本件について調査を行った結果、Jira MFTBCFFR-3159 のリカバリーを実施する際に、対象車両に対して重複したリサイクル料金オーダーが存在していることを確認しました。
重複したリサイクル料金オーダーのリカバリーを行う際、どのオーダーがシャシーオーダーにマッピングされ、UI 上のシャシーオーダー画面で表示されているかを確認します。
さらに、リサイクル料金オーダーに TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが存在するかを確認し、存在する場合はそのオーダーを最終的なものとし、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージが null のオーダーをアンマップします。
確認したところ、すべての重複したリサイクル料金オーダーは「Pending」ステータスであり、TOB ステータスおよびメッセージは null でした。
これらのオーダーの唯一の違いは「作成日（Created）」だったため、作成日が古いオーダーをアンマップし、最新の作成日のオーダーをシャシーオーダーにマッピングした状態で保持しました。
しかし、この作業の際に、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーが受注（Sales Order）にマッピングされている可能性を見落としていました。
その結果、UI 上で表示され、シャシーオーダー画面に表示されていた最新の作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーのステータスを更新し、古い作成日のリサイクル料金オーダーを車両からアンマップしました。
これにより、受注からもアンマップされてしまい、本件の問題が発生しました。
今後、同様の問題を防ぐため、重複したリサイクル料金オーダーを確認する際には、それらが受注にマッピングされているかどうかを追加で確認する手順を SOP に追加いたします。

よろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
After investigating this issue, we found that when performing the recovery of Jira MFTBCFFR-3159, there was a duplicate recycling fee order for the target vehicle.
When recovering duplicate recycle fee orders, check which orders are mapped to chassis orders and displayed on the chassis orders screen on the UI.
Additionally, it checks if the TOB status and message exist on the recycling fee order, makes it final if it exists, and unmaps orders with null TOB status and message.
I checked and found that all duplicate recycling fee orders were in a "Pending" status with a null TOB status and message.
The only difference between these orders was the "Created" date, so we unmapped the orders with the older creation dates and kept the orders with the latest creation dates mapped to the chassis orders.
However, during this process, they overlooked the possibility that recycling fee orders with old creation dates were mapped to Sales Orders.
As a result, we updated the status of recycle fee orders with the most recent creation date displayed on the UI and displayed on the Chassis Order screen, and unmapped recycle fee orders with older creation dates from the vehicle.
As a result, it was also unmapped from the order, causing this issue.
To prevent similar issues in the future, we will add a step to our SOPs when reviewing duplicate recycling fee orders to ensure they are mapped to a sales order.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you for your support.

comments.text:
角田様、
いつもお世話になっております。
以下、本件に関する分析結果をご報告いたします。ご確認のほど、よろしくお願い申し上げます。
24日の朝、D21N、D21R、及びD21Fファイルが実行されませんでした。
ログの分析の結果、データベース関連のエラーが原因でファイル処理が停止していたことが判明しました。
この問題は、FDP Chugokuで同時にトランザクションデータのロードが行われた影響により、データベースのメモリ使用量が高くなり、処理が停止したことが原因です。
メモリ関連の問題を解決するため、ITの承認を得た後、データベースのパラメータを調整いたしました（分析としては3184と同様）。
その後、問題は再発しておりません。
どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
Below, we will report the results of our analysis regarding this matter. Thank you for your understanding.
On the morning of the 24th, D21N, D21R, and D21F files were not executed.
Analysis of the logs revealed that file processing was stopped due to a database-related error.
This issue is caused by concurrent loading of transactional data in FDP Chugoku, resulting in high database memory usage and processing halts.
After getting IT approval, we adjusted the database parameters to resolve memory-related issues (same as 3184 for analysis).
The problem has not recurred since then.
Thank you very much for your support.
