comments.author: Sheetal
comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
*RCA:* In ODI, the logic for Sales Amount was expected to include values ('FDPレート') & ('ワランティレート'). 
 However, instead of these values, incorrect values such as ('FDP???') & ('????????') were observed.
Since this was a rare occurrence, no issues were previously identified related to this column.
However, in FDP Shikoku, for Order_num I00006001, the labor product is 'FDPレート' for line item (1-1A8DK0)  that does not satisfy the logic for Sales Price, leading the difference between the Sales Price in Siebel and the PBI Report.
 Please find the below attached screenshot.
To address this issue, we have modified the logic in FDP UAT(ODI) to ensure consistency and accurate data.
For Data testing, We'll create new record to test the code and data. 
 You can also create some sample data from your side on UAT so that we can test the changes.
Kindly let us know if you have any other queries.
Regards,
 Sheetal

Ashutosh さんのコメントの日本語版
お世話になっております。
問題について分析いたしましたので、以下の通りご報告申し上げます。
問題 - D21A　白紙になる
回答 -
この件につきましては、スケジュールパッケージの実行時にレコードが作成されますが、もしファイルが存在しない場合、BIPレポートが出力されないため、シートが白紙として印刷されることになります。
ご参考のために添付ファイルをご確認ください。
問題 - D21N　折り返し表示されて複数行となっている（注文番号、エンジン打刻）
回答 -
D21Nのファイル形式はすべての環境で同一です。このBIPは四国環境でも同様に印刷されています。
問題 - D21L？　別のデータがD21Lとして印刷されている？（添付参照）
回答 -
D21L用のファイルは存在しておらず、ユーザーがレポートタブからこのBIPを印刷している状況です。本来、ユーザーは「印刷」ボタンからレポートを印刷するべきです。
対策として、レポートタブからこのレポートを削除いたします。添付のスクリーンショットをご確認ください。
ご不明点等がございましたら、お知らせください。
よろしくお願い申し上げます。

Thank you for your support.
We have investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
 Expense charge to in Parts Expense Order and Parts expense order is set by Department code of the order creator. In the record mentioned above (Parts Expense Order : M000004280 and Parts Expense Return Order: M000004307), user D8MAEKAT created these records who have Department code 8030.
While creating Expense order, Department code of the creator is set as Expense charge to in Order. But user san changed the Expense charge to field as 8040 from Order screen. Hence, 8040 department code is set in Parts expense order.
When creating Parts expense return, department code of the creator was set in expense charge to field in parts expense return order which is 8030. On Parts Expense return screen the Expense charge to field shows value of the parent order, that is why 8040 is shown on UI but expense charge to field value in backend in 8030. 
Same mapping logic also exist in SC where Expense Return order shows Expense charge to value of parent order.
In JV, the correct mapping is done where Expense charge to field of the Expense return order is set in Department Code(CSJS300). 
To sum up, JV mapping is correct but on UI, parent order's Expense charge to field is shown in Expense return order. 
Fix Plan: Either we can change the Expense Charge to field mapping in Expense return order where we will show value of the return order rather than parent order expense charge value or we can change the mapping in JV where we will set Parent Order's expense charge to field value in Department Code(CSJS300) of Expense Return Order JV line. 
Kindly validate our analysis and let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
 Divyesh Ghiya

-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
Below is the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for this incident:-
As per the current functionality, there is a slight difference in the logic used to calculate the sales price between the 'Vehicle Order Sheet 1' and the 'Vehicle Order Sheet 2'.
'Vehicle Order Sheet 1' includes the price of 'Service Effort' when calculating the sales price. 'Vehicle Order Sheet 2', however, does not include the price of 'Service Effort'.
This results in a difference of ¥20,000 between 'Vehicle Order Sheet 1' and 'Vehicle Order Sheet 2'.
 
Kindly let us know if you would like us to apply the same logic for 'Vehicle Order Sheet 2' as used in 'Vehicle Order Sheet 1'.
Thanks and regards,
Laxminarayan Meena.

-San,
As per current logic, Tax is calculated as sum of "Net Price" in Tax & Expenses tab and "Total Selling Price" but if "License Plate Number Fee" and "Illuminated License Plate Number Fee" has price then these prices are subtracted from the Total amount.
Total Amount: 65000
License Plate Number Fee: 6000
Fee License Plate Number Fee: 7000
Consumption Tax Rate: 10
Taxable Amount = 65000 - (6000 + 7000) = 52000
Tax Amount = 5200
This logic is present on all FDPs that  "License Plate Number Fee" and "Illuminated License Plate Number Fee" is subtracted from net taxable amount.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Best Regards,
Atul Yadav

Thank you for your help.
Regarding this latest issue, there was a problem in the ODI package related to the processing of TOB files. Therefore, in order to resolve this issue, we applied the ODI patch on Sunday, January 19, 2025. This modification is only related to ODI.
Additionally, it is not practical for the business team to check the processing of ODI packages, so we do not check the processing of ODI packages.
After implementing the fix, we have confirmed that the problem no longer occurs.
Additionally, to monitor when TOB files are not processed, we have automation within our system so that you can receive email notifications if there are any outstanding files from the ODI system.
Therefore, we have applied a correction and monitoring system to the processing of TOB files, so we will consider this issue resolved.
If you have any questions in the future, please let us know.

Thank you for your continued support.
We have thoroughly analyzed the reported issue and successfully replicated it in the UAT1 environment. Please refer to UV Sales Order E001287415, where the Sales Posting process has not been completed, and the status remains stuck at Delivery Pending Approval.
Our investigation indicates that this is a random behavior in the Sales Posting process, occurring in rare cases where the status is not updated correctly.
To address this, we are implementing the following measures:
Code Optimization: We are refining the code to eliminate such random behavior and ensure the process works reliably.
Monitoring: We will closely monitor the Sales Posting Completed process for both NV and UV orders to prevent recurrence of similar incidents.
We kindly request your confirmation of our analysis and approval to proceed with the proposed fix. Upon your approval, we plan to include this fix in the next scheduled FDP release, planned for 23 January.
Please let us know if you have any questions or require further clarification.
Best regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

Mr. Tsunoda,
Thank you for your continued support.
Sorry for the late reply.
This Jira occurred due to an error when approving a vehicle delivery request, and as a result of investigation, it was found that the vehicle registered in the bodywork order and the vehicle registered in the order were different. This case concerns trailers and forklifts.
This event is related to Jira number MFTBCFFR-2834. Although the vehicle information in the order was updated during the Jira recovery, it was not reflected in the bodywork order, which caused the inconsistency like this one.
Therefore, we have determined that this issue was caused by a failure to respond during recovery. We will review and improve our recovery procedures to prevent similar events from occurring in the future.
Thank you for your support.

comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue and this is a bug in this functionality. When the user tries to complete the 'Delivery Request', the system checks if their Purchase Orders are mapped to that sales order(UV Purchase Order and UV Pool Cost - Procurement). And we have checked the record that you have provided and in that assessment, the Assessment purpose is 'FUSO Owned Vehicle'. In case of 'FUSO Owned Vehicle', after user approves the assessment request and status changes to 'Assessment Completed', 'Create Verification Request' button is activated and user directly creates the Stock-In Verification request, without creating the UV Purchase Order. Since while completing the delivery request, the system checks for  'UV Purchase Order' and 'UV Pool Cost - Procurement' and in this case, UV Purchase order is not created, the error popped up to map all the key components.
Along with 'FUSO Owned Vehicle', 'Create Verification Request' is active after approving the Assessment request for all the assessments with below listed 'Assessment Purpose':
 * FUSO Owned Vehicle
 * Buyback
 * Monitor Vehicle
 * Cancelled Vehicle
 * Caravan (less than a year)
 * Caravan (more than a year)
We will fix this issue on UAT environment. We can perform recovery for this record, but since Prod release in FDP is halted, we will not be able to release this incident to Prod environments until the next planned Prod release.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

「FUSO Owned Vehicle」の場合、上記の「Assessment Purpose」に該当するすべての査定において、「Create Verification Request」は査定依頼を承認した後にアクティブになります。
FUSO Owned Vehicle
Buyback
Monitor Vehicle
Cancelled Vehicle
Caravan (1年未満)
Caravan (1年以上)

何かご不明な点がございましたら、ご連絡ください。
よろしくお願い申し上げます。

comments.author: Akash
comments.text:
Thank you for your ongoing support. We have investigated the issue and found that it is due to a user mis-operation. This is related to FDP UAT-1, Reference JC# I001287533.
Here are the steps we followed to replicate the issue:
1.The user created a Work Order (WO), then created and got approval for a quote. After entering the Arrival Date/Time in the Job Card (JC) header, the JC status changed to "Vehicle Arrived."
2.The user drilled down into the WO, started and stopped the work, then clicked on the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button. The WO status changed to "Acceptance Inspection."
3.Since all WOs are now in "Acceptance Inspection" status, the work completion date/time of the last WO was set to the JC's work completion date/time.
4.The user created a new WO with a template, and the customer approved the quote.
5.The user then drilled down into the new WO, started and stopped the work, and tried to click the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button.
However, this action is not allowed in the SC, as the "Set Acceptance Inspection" button is not active in this case. You can refer to SC JC# I026301176 for more details.
Please let me know if you need any further clarification or assistance.
Regards,
Akash

After investigating the problem you pointed out, we found that the cause was an operational error by the user. This is related to FDP UAT-1 and is an issue with reference number JC# I001287533.

A user creates a work order (WO) and then creates a quote and gets it approved. After entering the arrival date and time in the job card (JC) header, the JC status was changed to "Vehicle Arrival".

The user created a new WO with the template and the customer approved the quote.
The user then opens a new WO, starts/finishes the work, and tries to click the "Acceptance Inspection Settings" button.
However, this operation is not allowed in the SC and in this case the "Acceptance Inspection Settings" button is not active. Please refer to SC JC# I026301176 for details.
If you need further clarification or assistance, please let us know.
Thank you for your understanding.

thank you.

4. 見積改訂 2 が承認されると、見積改訂 1 に関連する販売オーダーが「承認中」ステータスのままであれば、 販売オーダーはキャンセルされ、見積改訂 2 と同期されません。
 
「改訂」ボタンの現在の機能
1. このボタンは現在、キャンセルされた販売オーダー（見積改訂 1 に関連付けられている）のステータスをピックアップする。
2. ステータスが「キャンセル」であるため、「修正」ボタンは無効になる。
 
修正プラン
1. 現在の見積にキャンセルされた販売オーダーがあるかどうか確認する。
2. もしキャンセルされた販売オーダーが現在の見積に関連付けられている場合、「改訂 」ボタンは無効になる。
3. この特定のケースでは、現在の見積（見積改訂2）に関連する販売オーダーがないため、「改訂」ボタンは有効のままとなる。
 
UAT1で開発を進めるために、提案された修正プランの承認をお願いします。
 
ご不明な点がございましたら、お気軽にお問い合わせください。
 
よろしくお願いいたします。
ラクスミナラヤン・ミーナ

Mr. Tsunoda,
 
Thank you for your continued support.
 
As discussed in the meeting, the current feature details and fix plans are as follows:
 
user steps
1. Estimate revision 1 is created.
2. A sales order is created and remains in "Approving" status.
3. Estimate revision 2 is created.
4. Once quotation revision 2 is approved, if the sales order associated with quotation revision 1 remains in the Approving status, the sales order will be canceled and will not be synchronized with quotation revision 2.
 
Current function of the "Revise" button
1. This button currently picks up the status of the canceled sales order (associated with quote revision 1).
2. The "Modify" button is disabled because the status is "Cancelled".
 
correction plan
1. Check if there are any canceled sales orders in the current quote.
2. If a canceled sales order is associated with the current quote, the "Revise" button will be disabled.
3. In this particular case, there are no sales orders associated with the current quote (Quote Revision 2), so the Revise button remains enabled.
 
Please approve the proposed modification plan in order to proceed with development on UAT1.

Thank you for your support.
Laxminarayan Meena

Dear Miyauchi San,
Thank you for your support.
RCA : We have investigated the issue and we found that SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice is mapped with Last Updated date in case of Service Change Order.
As per the normal Process whenever the status of Service Change Order is set to Approved the order becomes Read Only. The Last Updated date is the same as Posting Date.
For this Order the Last Updated Date was changed to 6 Nov 2024 which was different from Posting Date due to some backend process and SMDO001 was set to 20241106.
I have attached the supporting screenshort.
Fix Plan : We will make a new Field to store the Approved Date and we will map that date Field with SMDO001 in Bulk Invoice for Service Change Order.
Please check and let us know for any queries.
Thanks
Amit

上のコメントの日本語版いつもお世話になっております。
RCA（根本原因分析）
この度の問題について調査を行った結果、サービスチェンジオーダーにおいて、一括請求書（Bulk Invoice）のSMDO001が最終更新日とマッピングされていることがわかりました。
通常のプロセスでは、サービスチェンジオーダーのステータスが「承認済み」に設定されると、その注文は「読み取り専用」となります。この際、最終更新日（Last Updated Date）はPosting Dateと同じになります。
しかし、この注文については、最終更新日が2024年11月6日に変更され、Posting dateとは異なり、バックエンドプロセスによりSMDO001が20241106に設定されました。
関連するスクリーンショットを添付いたしますので、ご確認ください。
修正計画
承認日を格納する新しいフィールドを作成し、その日付フィールドをサービスチェンジオーダーの一括請求書におけるSMDO001とマッピングいたします。
ご確認の上、何かご不明点がございましたらお知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。

Thank you for your continued support of the Japanese version of the comment above.
RCA (root cause analysis)
After investigating this issue, we found that SMDO001 of the Bulk Invoice was mapped to the last updated date in the Service Change Order.
The normal process is that once a service change order's status is set to "Approved," the order becomes "read-only." In this case, the Last Updated Date will be the same as the Posting Date.
However, for this order, the Last Modified Date was changed to November 6, 2024, and unlike the Posting date, the backend process set SMDO001 to 20241106.
Please check the attached screenshots.
modification plan
Create a new field to store the approval date and map that date field to SMDO001 in the Service Change Order Consolidated Invoice.
Please check it out and let us know if you have any questions.
Thank you very much for your support.

Dear Shiromoto-san,
Thank you for your continued support.
We have analyzed the issue and identified the following:
1. When the 'Job Card No' field has a value in the order activity, the 'Job Card Type' field becomes read-only:-
2. When the 'Job Card No' field is null in the order activity, the 'Job Card Type' field remains editable:-
Root Cause:-
 During the creation of an 'Order Activity', the 'Job Card Type' field is set to null, while the 'Job Card No' field is assigned a value (e.g., JC#). This results in the 'Job Card Type' field remaining null and read-only, restricting the user from entering a value.
Fix Plan:
 We propose modifying the process so that during the creation of an 'Order Activity,' the system will populate the 'Job Card Type' field in 'Order Activity' using the "JC Type" value from the 'Job Card.'
Please approve this fix plan so that we can proceed with development in the UAT environment.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Thanks and regards,
 Laxminarayan Meena.

Thank you for your support.
We have analyzed this issue and we have found that the user 'D8HITASH' has a position type as 'Branch-Sales-Staff'. We checked the view role matrix for Aomori environment and as per that document, this view is read-only for users with responsibility 'MF Branch-Sales-Staff'. Hence, for this user, you are not able to make any changes on UI.
And for other 'Sales-Staff' users, they have position type as 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff', for which, as per the view role matrix, this view is editable.
If business requires, we can change the position type for this user to 'Branch NV/UV Sales Staff'. You will need to raise an SR to update the Employee master, with corresponding position for this user in the employee master file.
Since this is working correctly as per the existing functionality and is not a bug, kindly allow us to reject this Jira.
Thanks,
Abhishek Singh.

また、ビジネスチームにおいてODIパッケージの処理を確認することは現実的ではないため、ビジネスチームによる確認は行っておりません。
修正実施後、現在は問題が発生していないことを確認しています。
さらに、TOBファイルが処理されていない場合を監視するために、システム内で自動化を行い、ODIシステムから未処理のファイルがある場合にメールで通知を受け取れるようにしています。
そのため、TOBファイルの処理に関しては修正と監視システムを適用済みですので、本件は解決済みとさせていただきます。
今後、何かご不明点等がございましたら、お知らせください。
宜しくお願い致します。

城本様、
お世話になっております。
問題: UVインボックス承認エラー
原因調査 (RCA): ユーザーステップは以下の通りです：
1．見積-1-1WQC6R(改訂版1)を作成し、見積を承認しました。
2．受注「E000247317」を作成しました。
3．「承認依頼」ボタンをクリックして、受注の承認を生成しました。
4．ユーザーが受注を承認しなかったため、受注は「承認待ち」の状態のままでした。
5．ユーザーは「改訂」ボタンをクリックして、新しい見積（改訂版2）を作成し、見積を承認しました。
6．受注が「承認待ち」の状態のままだったため、見積-1-1WQC6R(改訂版2)を承認すると、受注のステータスは「キャンセル済み」となりました。
7．その後、ユーザーは受注を「却下」または「承認済み」しようとしましたが、受注のステータスが「キャンセル済み」から「却下」または「承認済み」に変更できる可能性がなかったため、できませんでした。
修正計画: 修正は不要です。問題はユーザーの操作ミスによるものです。
上記のシナリオでは: ユーザーはまず受注を承認し、その後見積を改訂する必要があります。または、キャンセルされた受注を使用する代わりに、新しい受注を作成するべきです。
ご不明点がございましたら、お知らせください。
どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。
ヒマンシュ
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Shiromoto,
Thank you for your help.
Problem: UV Inbox Approval Error
Cause Investigation (RCA): User steps are as follows:
1. We have created Quotation-1-1WQC6R (revised version 1) and approved the quotation.
2. Order "E000247317" has been created.
3． You generated an approval for the order by clicking the Request Approval button.
4. The order remained in the "Waiting for approval" state because the user did not approve the order.
5. The user clicked the Revise button to create a new quote (Revision 2) and approve the quote.
6. The order was still in the "Awaiting Approval" state, so after approving the quotation -1-1WQC6R (Revised Version 2), the order's status became "Cancelled".
7. The user then tried to "Reject" or "Approved" the order, but was unable to do so because there was no possibility to change the order's status from "Cancelled" to "Rejected" or "Approved".
Remediation plan: No modification required. The problem is due to user error.
In the above scenario: The user must first approve the order and then revise the quote. Or you should create a new order instead of using the canceled order.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you very much for your support.
Himanshu

comments.author: Laxminarayan Meena
comments.text:
Dear San,
Thank you for your support.
Issue:- UV In-Box Approval Error.
RCA:- User steps are as follows:-
1. Created Quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 1 and approved the quote.
2. Created Sales Order 'E000247317'.
3. Generated Approvals of sales order by clicking on "Generate Approval" button.
4. Sales Order status left in "Pending Approval" as user has not approved the sales order.
5. User created a new quote with revision 2 by clicking on "Revise" button and approved the quote.
6. As Sales order was left in 'Pending Approval' status, by approving quote '1-1WQC6R' revision 2, Sales order status was set to "Cancelled".
7. Then user tried to Reject/Approve the sales order but it was not possible to Reject/Approve it because Sales order status can not be changed from "Cancelled" to "Rejected/Approved".
 
Fix Plan:-No Fix required. As the issue occured due to user mis operation.
In the above scenario:-
Either User should approve the Sales Order first and then should revise the quote, Or User should create a new Sales order instead of using the cancelled sales order.
Kindly let us know in case of any queries.
Thanks and regards,
Laxminarayan Meena.

Thank you for your support.
I wanted to clarify that for local parts approval, the criteria are based on the cost ratio rather than the discount rate. In the current quote, which includes a local part as a line item, the cost ratio is set at 100.
When a parts staff member requests a quote with a local part, the approval condition requires the cost ratio to be between 0 and 105, with the customer type designated as "customer." Answer: We have checked the 'Consumption Tax' field on Body Building Orders. It is a column based field which stores the total tax of line items when amount is entered in line items. Since, it is column based field, tax is not updated when line item is cancelled.
 
Question:2 Can Acceptance verification be done for Body building order when the line item is cancelled?
Answer: Yes, 'Acceptance Verification Done' status is possible for Body Building Orders with cancelled line items.

comments.text_enu:
Mr.
Thank you for your hard work.
After confirming this issue, we found that work was being done on the database on September 16th, which caused the database to be down. The file ran fine, but the database was down so the changes were not reflected in the application. Therefore, the status of the corresponding order was not updated on the UI.
As a future precaution, plan your database work so that it does not affect normal file execution.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Thank you for your understanding.

Please let us know if you have any queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

Dear Shiromoto San,
Thank you for your support. We have investigated the issue, and here are our findings:
1.The Sales Posting for Order-A000086482 was completed on 5 August 2024. At that time, the cost was null for Model Code of Chassis Order line item(B000087336), so the Journal Voucher for the Sales Posting Chassis was not created.
In normal Process Journal Voucher for the Sales Posting Chassis is created when cost is not null and 0.
2. The Recovery for Order-B000087336 was done on 9 August 2024, as mentioned in MFTBCFFR-2423 (VO_シャシ金額が表示されていない) in which cost was updated for the line item.
We will proceed with the Recovery of the Order. Please allow us to close the incident.
Thanks
Amit

The Recovery has been completed on our side.

 D21Cファイル「D21C_28082024113224」を受領しましたが、ふそう受付番号‐306330に関する詳細は含まれていましたが、C#確認および他の車両データが欠けていたため、オーダーステータスは「オーダー済み（Ordered）」となっていました。
同じファイル内で、305519のC#確認データも受け取っていませんでしたが、このシャーシについては後にD21Gファイルが共有され、その結果、オーダーステータスは「C#確認済み」に変更されました。
システムには問題はありません。D21Gファイルがふそう受付番号‐ 306330のシャーシオーダーに対して受領され次第、ステータスは「C#確認済み」に変更されます。
また、シャーシオーダーが見えないとご指摘いただきましたが、 306330のシャーシオーダーは函館本番で確認できます。添付されているスクリーンショットをご参照ください。
D21Cファイルの機能は正常に動作しているため、このJiraは却下させていただきます。
 ご質問がございましたら、お知らせください。
よろしくお願いいたします。
 ヒマンシュ

お疲れ様です。
シャーシオーダー番号: B000159393
この件に関して、調査した結果、Posting date（伝票日付）がPO（シャーシオーダー）の実際の出荷日とマッピングされていることが分かりました。
シャーシオーダーはTOBからいただいているD21Eファイルを通じて作成されて、シャーシオーダーのステータスが「出荷指示済み」になるとJV（仕訳伝票）が作成されます。このオーダーでは、実際の出荷日がTOBからいただいているD21Zファイルを通じて20240731に更新されて、その後JVが送信されたため、Posting date（伝票日付）が20240731に設定されました。
 現在のロジックでは、実際の出荷日がnullの場合、JVのPosting date（伝票日付）はJVが作成されたタイムスタンプに設定されます。
 リカバリーは完了しましたので、JIRAをクローズしてくださいませんか。
宜しくお願い致します。
comments.text_enu:
good work.
Chassis order number: B000159393
After investigating this issue, we found that the posting date was mapped to the actual shipping date of the PO (chassis order).
Chassis orders are created using the D21E file received from the TOB, and when the status of the chassis order becomes "shipping ordered", a JV (journal entry voucher) is created. For this order, the actual shipping date was updated to 20240731 through the D21Z file received from the TOB, and then the JV was submitted, so the Posting date was set to 20240731.
 The current logic is that if the actual shipping date is null, the JV's Posting date will be set to the timestamp when the JV was created.

Thank you for your support.
We investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:
The issue occurred because D21F file received on 20 Aug evening was not processed in ODI.
During the recovery of incident MFTBCFFR-2441, we were re-running D21E files in Aomori Prod environment. At that time, D21F file was present in the Inbound folder, we were checking the data of the files and opened D21F file too, this caused D21F not be latest file on path. When ODI package was executed, it searched for the latest file and no file was detected. 
Countermeasure: We generally do not perform recovery of D21 files, but for the future we have added an extra step to not open additional files present in the Inbound folder.
Recovery is completed now on prod and recycle fee data is shown correctly. Please allow us to close the incident.
Please let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

We have analyzed this issue and we have below finding:-
The Trade-in assessment# H000004008 was included in NV Quote# 1-UJYUK. Revision 2 of NV Quote# 1-UJYUK was attached to order# A000109884, which was subsequently rejected. When the user created and approved revision 3 of NV Quote# 1-UJYUK, the synchronization process from the NV quote to the NV sales order generated PO# F000110671. comments.author: Sunil Kumar
comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
We have found rca of this issue and are describing below step by step:-
For NV Case:
1.The user created an NV Quote with a Trade-In and used the auto-order button to generate an NV Sales Order, which initially had a status of 'Pending'.
2.The user then clicked the 'Generate Approval' button for the NV Sales Order but rejected the approval, resulting in the NV Sales Order status being updated to 'Rejected'.
3.The user revised the NV Quote (Revision 1) to NV Quote (Revision 2) and approved NV Quote (Revision 2).
4.NV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the NV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.
5.Since the Auto Order button is enabled in NV Quote (Revision 2), the user can generate a new NV Sales Order by clicking it.
Even though the NV Sales Order is in a 'Rejected' status, a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In will created.
For UV Case:
1.The user created a UV Quote with a Trade-In and used the auto-order button to generate a UV Sales Order with a 'Pending' status.
2.Revise UV Quote(Revision 1) to UV Quote(Revision 2) and approved UV Quote(Revision 2)
3.UV Quote (Revision 2) synchronized with the UV Sales Order, triggering the creation of a UV Purchase Order for the Trade-In.
Even though the UV Sales Order is in 'Pending' status, a UV Purchase Order for Trade In will create.
Let us know if you have any query.
Best Regards,
Sunil Kumar

角田さん、
 
この問題について徹底的に調査した結果、マスターにおいて「Bundle」という値に変更されたフラグが存在しており、そのためにネット価格の代わりに「0」が渡されていたことが判明しました。
 
このため、マスターレコードの手動更新の可能性を排除するために、そのビューを読み取り専用にするという解決策を考案しました。これにより、マスターに対する手動変更の可能性が完全に排除されます。
 
ご不明な点がございましたら、お知らせください。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda,
 
After thorough investigation into this issue, we discovered that there was a flag in the master that had been changed to a value of 'Bundle', which was causing '0' to be passed instead of the net price.
 
For this reason, I devised a solution to make that view read-only to eliminate the possibility of manual updates to the master record. This completely eliminates the possibility of manual changes to the master.
 
If you have any questions, please let us know.

comments.text:
We have analyzed this issue and we have found that in this record, there was an assessment created with the same vehicle, in cancelled status. When an assessment is cancelled, a flag is set to 'Y' for all the POs mapped to that vehicle, so that when another assessment is created with same VIN# and their purchase orders are created, only the newest POs get mapped in the sales order.
While creating a delivery request, this flag was not checked, and hence the error was shown that all purchase orders are not mapped.
We have fixed this condition for Delivery Request creation and the changes are now available on UAT1 environment.
Kindly verify the same and let us know if you face any issues.
Once validated, kindly approve the same for Prod release.
Thanks,
Abhishek Singh.

comments.text:
We have analyzed this issue and we have found that in a quote, for Body Line Items, when the user presses 'Send to IBOS' button, a single IBOS number is generated for a single body, and it is unique for every body line item added.
The IBOS number generated for a Body does not change, as it is unique for that body line item, and irrespective of the number of child sales orders, the IBOS number for a body does not change.
It cannot be different in different child sales orders. Because of the unique nature of IBOS number for every 'Body' line item, it is not possible that it'll be different in child sales orders.
This is functioning same as in SC version.
If you have any queries, kindly let us know. We can set up a meeting and have a discussion regarding this.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

Thank you for your support.
We have done analysis and The root cause of this issue is explained below in details.
1.The NV Sales Order Report is generated based on the "Sales Order Date" visible in the user interface (UI). We have attached a screenshot of the UI for your reference.
2.The "Sales Order Date" field on the UI is editable for users whose organization type is not "Branch" for their division of primary position.
3.Therefore, users can change the value of the "Sales Order Date" field, causing discrepancies in the NV Sales Order Report.
Let us know if you have any query.
Best Regards,
Sunil Kumar

We investigated this issue thoroughly and below are our findings:

The correct value of the shop code should be 00, the wrong value was reflected because of the error in employee master update. The data in the initial file of the employee code was wrong for Location code, which was then corrected by second file received from the business.
As a countermeasure, we will monitor the Employee master records which re run. We will check the location code. 
Recovery: The user created another SR in which correct values are being reflected, the completion of this SR will populate correct responsible shop code in account master.

Divyesh Ghiya

We have analysed this issue and we have found that on 1st April,2024, an employee master file was executed on Prod. 
As per that file, the user initially assigned to Branch-CS-Head position, D8TOTAKE, was deleted and after that operation, same position was to be assigned to D8TMASAA.
But in that step, the operation to be performed on D8TMASAA was given as 'Assign' in the file provided to us. It should have been 'Change' for that step to be executed correctly. 
Hence, the user that was initially assigned the role of Branch-CS-Head position was deleted and no new user was assigned that position. And therefore, no user appeared in the approval flow history for Branch-CS-Head role.
PFA the screenshot from the file that was run on 1st April,2024 for your reference.
Kindly let us know if you have any queries.
Regards,

We have analyzed this issue and we have found that in the employee master file that we receive, there's a column for position of the employee. When this file is executed, a script is run in which we look for the position type mapped to the position that we receive in the file. Currently in Position Type Mapping, Branch-CS-Head was mapped to Branch-Service-Mgr. So when employee master was executed on 1st April, 2024, the user, D8TMASAA was assigned the role of Branch-Service-Mgr. 
Thus, there was no employee that was assigned the role of Branch-CS-Head, in Division 10.
We have corrected the mapping and executed the employee master file for that user, after which, it was correctly assigned the role of Branch-CS-Head in Division 10.
Kindly let us know if you have any queries.
Thanks,
Abhishek Singh.

Mr. Ikezawa,
(The following is a Japanese translation of Abhishek's comment)
We investigated this issue and found that there was a position column for employees in the employee master file we received. Executing this file will run a script that checks whether the position type is mapped in the received file. Currently, branch factory manager was mapped to branch service manager in position type mapping. Therefore, when the employee master was executed on April 1, 2024, the user D8TMASAA was assigned to the role of Branch Service Manager. 
Thus, there were no employees assigned to the role of Branch Plant Manager in Division 10.
We corrected the mapping for that user, ran the employee master, and then the user was correctly assigned to the role of Branch Factory Manager in Division 10.
If you have any questions, please let us know.
Abhishek Singh.

After thorough analysis, we have identified the root cause of the issue that is related to Incident Jira 2182. The cause was due to some incorrect steps taken during the recovery process. These steps are outlined below:
1.Model Master Price execution on production was conducted on 8th March.
2.The Model Master Price for Model Code (SO# A000090515) was updated with the latest price.
3.Recovery was performed for Jira 2182.
4.However, the recovery was executed using the wrong ROW_ID of the record that fetched the latest price from the model master for the specific model code.
As discussed in our meeting, we will take steps to prevent this issue from occurring in the future.
We deeply regret for the incovenience caused. 
We kindly request permission to close this Jira.
Best Regards,
Sunil Kumar

Dear Nakane San,
 
Thank you for your support.
 
RCA : The settlement date in the PBI updates the LAST_UPD date of the Service Change Order. 
 
Initially, when the JC#：I000097002(Change Order＃：K000121869) was created on March 18th, the LAST_UPD date was set as March 18th. 
 
Subsequently, on March 19th, when the JC#：I000097002(Change Order＃：K000121869) was updated, the LAST_UPD date changed to March 19th, and this update was also reflected in the PBI. So 19th March is correct.
 
Kindly let us know for more explanations.
 
Regards,
 
Sheetal

comments.text:
Dear Shiromoto san,
We have analyzed this issue and we've found that Assessment purpose is editable even when the status of the assessment is 'Assessment Completed'. Since it is editable, user can change the assessment purpose, and in that process, if we set the assessment purpose to null, although it will not be saved, but its purchase type will be set to null. And then as soon as we press Esc, the assessment purpose will be set back to its previous value, but now, its purchase type has been set to null. Thus, causing this issue.
User steps would be:
 # Create an assessment and approve it
 # Since assessment purpose is editable, trying to change it.
 # Changing the assessment purpose mid process back to its previous value(Pressing Esc)
 # Now, on UI, Assessment purpose is set back to its original value. But in that process, the purchase type for that assessment is set to null.
Let us know if you have any queries.
Regards,
Abhishek Singh.

comments.author: Khushi Mulge.
comments.text:
Thank you for your support.
RCA for this incident:
For UV SO# E000087121, the steps user has followed: 
1. User had filled the Approval Date manually in More Info of UV Sales Order Screen. 
2. Then User has generate approval.
3. The Sales Order was rejected by Branch Head.
4. So the status is rejected, but since Approval Date is filled, SO is showing in Order Report.
Usually, Approval Date field is auto populated, when the approvers approve the Sales Order. 
On the Sales Order Reporting screen, the Approved Orders are filtered on basis of Approved Date.
As for UV SO# E000037797, the steps user has followed: 
1. The user had filled the Delivery Completion Approved Date manually in the Sales Posting section of UV Sales Order screen. 
2. And then user has generated Approval.
3. This field is populated when Delivery Request is completed. 
On the Sales Order Reporting screen, the Sales Posting Completed Orders are filtered on basis of Delivery Completion Approved Date. 
Due to this, the SO is showing in Sales Report.
Let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Khushi Mulge.

本インシデントの原因分析です:
UV SO# E000087121でユーザーが実施したステップになります:

comments.author: Divyesh Ghiya
comments.text:
We investigated this issue thorughly and below are our findings:
In Sales Order, tax percent comes from the sales quote but there is a logic written behind Generate Approval button. In this logic, Whenever user clicks generate approval, tax rate is being searched in Consumption Tax Master in following manner:
First, query by acknowledgment date in consumption master, 
if acknowledgment date is >= Today then:
Condition 1: Last Contract Date <= Acknowledgment Date
Condition 2: Last Contract Date >= Acknowledgment Date
else,
Condition 3: acknowledgment date < Today
For condition 1 and 3, we then query start date <= Last Contract Date <= End Date
For condition 2, we query start date <= Planned Delivery Date <= End Date
In FDP-Okayama, Acknowledgment date is 2020/11/30(which is less then today), so condition 3 will be followed and query will be done on the basis of Last Contract Date in Sales Order. In all the orders we shared with you, you can find that last contract date was less then start date(2023/07/29), hence there were 0 results of the query and tax percent was set to null.
*This logic is same as in SC.*
We replicated the same test case in SC UAT1 where se set Last Contract Date(2018/01/31) less then Start Date (2020/11/30) in Order A025013709. In this case also, tax percent was set to null and order sheet bip was failed.
one solution to avoid this in FDP is to set Start Date same as SC so that query will not give null result and tax percent is set properly.
Kindly, confirm this RCA and let us know if you have any query.
Regards,
Divyesh Ghiya

User selected active flag of the record as N and proceeded with Estimation of the Parts Quote. By clicking Active flag as N, record becomes inactive and can not be updated. Hence, status was not changed when estimation button was pressed and error pop up warning 'The record in not editable'.

We have replicated the same process on UAT1 and have observed the RCA for the error that occurred.
 The RCA for error caused was user mistake only.
 The steps performed by the user were:
 After creating the quote and clicking the Generate Approval button, the user changed the value of Print Order in the line items, which was editable, which is why the error occurred.
 The Status is set Approved in Approval Tab but Quote is not Approved. 
 The correct way to perform these steps was:
 After creating the quote, the user should make the changes he wants to make before clicking on the Generate Approval Button.
 No change in Quote should be made after Generate Approval. The process will run smoothly and no errors will occur.
 For references in UAT:-
 Quote:- 1-40NT88
 Job Card: I001236399
Regards,
 kartik chanana

We analyzed this issue further and we have found that this is a case of user misoperation. At the time when the delivery request approval is given, the UI is editable just before the status is set to Sales Posting Completed. Issue- APIs not working
Resolution- Docker Gateway containers were not working. We started all docker containers which connect to backend API hits. It's because this server got rebooted on its own this morning.

RCA - oneAPI KONG Gateway server got an unplanned reboot on 16-Oct-2023. Due to which the Docker Services which are responsible for API connection got failed and the user got the error.
Countermeasure - Siebel have raised the concern to Azure support separately. And we are also adding the KONG Gateway server to FORCEMON monitoring system to get the Realtime update on server health to avoid such situations in future.

comments.author: Sheetal
comments.text:
Dear Nakane San,
Thank You for your Support.
The "Latest_flg" field in the ODI mapping is sourced from the "Active_Flg" field in the Siebel table named "s_doc_quote".
Basically  "Active_Flg" indicates the active quote. A single quote can have multiple revisions, and the revision that is currently active is identified by having its active flag set to true.
Regards,
Sheetal

Here is the root cause of why this issue happened.
 # During Initial development of Real Time Invoice API, both Planned Delivery Date and Requested Registration Date field were mapped to the Invoice.
 # This mapping failed when Real Time Invoice was tested for the orders where Registration and Delivery was completed (In this case Actual Delivery/Registration dates should have been displayed in Invoice).
 # To fix the above issue, Actual Delivery/Registration Date was mapped to Invoice. However this solution was also incorrect as the logic should have been created as per the completion/Pending of registration and delivery.
 # As this logic was partially implemented in UAT itself, the same code was migrated to production and hence this issue occurred.

Dear Shiromoto San,

PFB analysis for this case, As per the current code below code flow triggers:
1- Assessment Request Stock in Verification Completed.
2- Vehicle value updates on UV Inventory with Purchase Price from UV Purchase Order.
3- Based on UV Inventory update, Vehicle value updates on Assessment Request.
In this case, As the same values (1,034,500.) already exists in Vehicle value of UV Inventory. 
It is updated when Assessment # H000000001 Completed Re-evalution request with same Vehicle value which is 1,034,500.
So in Step 2 No update on Vehicle value in UV inventory.
So step 3 is not triggered.
*Solution*: As it is a case when user needs to recover record for Assessment Cancelled.
We can add a recovery step as to set null vehicle value in UV Inventory.

城本さん、
（以下はAbhishekのコメントの和訳になります）
本件に関する以下の調査結果をご覧ください。現状のプログラムでは以下のコードの流れで起動します。
1- 査定依頼入庫検収完了
2- 中古車買取オーダーから中古車在庫の買取価格と車両簿価が更新
3- 中古車在庫の更新により査定依頼の車両簿価が更新
この場合、中古車在庫の車両簿価に既に同額（1,034,500)が存在しているため
査定番号# H000000001が完了し同額の1,034,500の車両簿価で評価替え依頼が更新されます。このため、ステップ２では中古車在庫の車両簿価は更新されず、ステップ３が起動されません。
*解決策*: 査定キャンセルに対しユーザーがデータをリカバリーするケースですので、中古車在庫にヌルの値を設定するリカバリーステップを追加する事が出来ます。

Mr. Shiromoto,
(The following is a Japanese translation of Abhishek's comment)
Please see the findings below regarding this matter. The current program starts with the following code flow.
1- Appraisal request and warehouse inspection completed
2- The purchase price and vehicle book value of used car inventory are updated from the used car purchase order.
3- The book value of the vehicle requested for appraisal is updated due to the updated used car inventory.
In this case, the same amount (1,034,500) already exists in the book value of the used car inventory.
Appraisal number # H000000001 is completed and the revaluation request is updated with the same vehicle book value of 1,034,500. Therefore, in step 2, the vehicle book value of the used car inventory is not updated and step 3 is not activated.
*Solution*: Since this is a case where the user needs to recover data after the appraisal is canceled, you can add a recovery step to set a null value to the used car inventory.

-------
JAP:
注文の割り当てと出荷通知で発生したすべての問題は、「CPI ミドルウェア構成の構成 (設定) に関する技術的問題」という 1 つの問題が原因です。 (#520341066) 
修正はすでに適用され、完全に実装されています。
 残念ながら、以前に回復されたケースではこの種のタイミングの問題を回避することはできません。
注文割り当ての回復が完了するまでに、倉庫運用チームが出荷文書を作成すると、DMS システムが出荷通知を受け取る前に出荷通知を受信することになるためです。
すべての注文の回復は完全に完了しましたが、2023 年 8 月 17 日から 2023 年 8 月 23 日までに D2S で作成された FDP 販売注文の一部でこのようなタイミングの問題が発生しました。 
 
上で説明したこのタイミングの問題は、倉庫作業のため避けられません。 現在、ハイパーケア中に問題の大部分が修正されているため、システムがほぼ安定し、最終的にはこれらの新しい顧客コードの注文も他の DMS 顧客と同様に正常に動作していることを確認できることを願っています。 
本日 (2023 年 8 月 24 日) 以降に作成された FDP 注文には、そのような問題は発生しません。
 
 
ENG:
All the issues that happened with Order Allocation and Shipment notification is only because of one issue – “Technical Issue with configuring(setting) up the CPI Middleware configuration”. (#520341066) While the fixes are already in place and fully implemented.
Unfortunately, these kind of timing issues cannot be avoided for the previously recovered cases because by the time we complete the recovery for Order allocations, if the warehouse Operations Team creates a shipment document, then it will result in DMS system receiving the shipment notifications prior to Order Allocations.
Such timing issues for few of the FDP Sales Orders created in D2S from 17th August 2023 till 23rd August 2023 though the recovery has been fully complete for all the Orders. This timing issue as explained above cannot be avoided because of warehouse activities.
As the majority of the issues are fixed during the hyper care now, we hope the system is pretty much stable and eventually you will witness that Orders for these new customer codes are also behaving normally like other DMS customers.
FDP orders created from today onwards (24th August 2023) will not have any such issues anymore.

Mr. Ikezawa, Mr. Sasaki,
(The following is a Japanese translation of Ravi's comment)
We have confirmed this matter, and below are our confirmation results and proposed solution. Please give us your feedback on this.
 
Case 1. When uploading a vehicle inspection certificate, if the creation date is greater than the existing vehicle inspection certificate, there is no problem even if the expiration date is blank.
 Case 2. When uploading a vehicle inspection certificate, if the creation date is older than the existing vehicle inspection certificate and the expiration date is blank, the vehicle inspection expiration date will not be updated correctly.
 
Solution 1: Solve the Okayama Fuso problem by patching the data. Since the program will not be changed, it is necessary to check whether there is an expiration date for future FDPs.
Solution 2: Change the program to ignore the vehicle inspection certificate if the expiration date is blank.
Solution 3: If the expiration date is blank, set the current date as the expiration date.
Solution 4: Before uploading a new vehicle inspection certificate, add validation so that the user manually sets the expiration date on the vehicle inspection certificate correction screen.
Note: The field in the file that we are using for the expiration date is ON_EXPIRTN_DT_VBALIDITY_PERIOD.

comments.text:
Dear Tsunoda San, Nakamura San,
TCB01 package scheduled update is changing the status of Chassis Orders from Shipment Instructed to Ordered.
As a preventive measure TCB01 schedule is stopped.
Root cause for the issue is below:
In SC Force, TCB01 package is picking Chassis Orders with Status as Shipment Instructed and RF Status as ‘Send Shipment to RF’ and changing the status to Ordered.
Since RF is unplugged in FDP, we are modifying the package as per KB status update.
As a solution, we have updated condition for KB in package.
We have implemented changed on UAT.
Please confirm changes on UAT.

角田さん、中村さん、
（Abhishekのメッセージ翻訳です）
TCB01 パッケージのスケジュールされた更新によりステータスがシャシ発注のステータスを出荷指示済から発注済に変更されています。
予防策としてTCB01の更新スケジュールを止めました。
この問題の主原因は以下の通りとなります：
SC版 Forceでは、TCB01のパッケージでシャシ発注のステータスが出荷指示済でRFのステータスが「出荷情報RF送信済」のものを抽出し、ステータスを発注済に変更しています。
FDP版ではRFとの接続を切っていますので、パッケージをKBステータスの更新に改修しています。
解決策として、パッケージ内のKBの条件を更新しました。
当方でUAT上に変更の対応しましたので、UATでの確認をお願い致します。
comments.text_enu:
Mr. Tsunoda, Mr. Nakamura,
(Abhishek's message translation)
A scheduled update of the TCB01 package has changed the status of the chassis order from Ordered to Ordered.
As a precautionary measure, we have stopped the update schedule for TCB01.
The main causes of this problem are:
In the SC version Force, we extract the TCB01 packages whose chassis order status is "shipping instructed" and whose RF status is "shipping information RF sent" and change the status to "ordered".
In the FDP version, the connection with RF is disconnected, so the package has been modified to update the KB status.
As a solution, I updated the conditions in the KB in the package.
We have made the changes on UAT, so please check on UAT.

The editable condition of highlighted fields are depend on LBC Number and this condition is same on SC and FDP both.
If LBC number is present then those fields will be non-editable but if LBC number is not present, then we can edit those highlighted fields.
This condition on SC is not working correctly because of the syntax is wrong but in FDP it is working because we have corrected it to resolve performance issue.
In SC, the condition is:
IIf((= LookupValue ("ACCOUNT_TYPE", "Company") && IS NOT NULL ), "Y", "N")
In FDP, the condition is:
IIf(( = LookupValue ("ACCOUNT_TYPE", "Company") AND IS NOT NULL ), "Y", "N")
We have replaced && to AND in FDP to fix related issues.
Do let us know if there is any concern.
